//! Durable, single-process-writer event ledger primitives.
//!
//! This crate cannot submit, sign or cancel venue orders. Each append returns
//! only after an SQLite FULL-synchronous transaction commits. The exact stored
//! bytes are chained; parsing and authorization are separate, future layers.

use fs2::FileExt;
use rusqlite::{params, Connection, OptionalExtension, TransactionBehavior};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::error::Error;
use std::fmt;
use std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};
use std::io;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

pub const MAX_EVENT_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const SCHEMA_VERSION: i64 = 1;
const GENESIS: [u8; 32] = [0; 32];

/// SHA-256(previous_hash || u64_be(length) || exact_event_bytes).
pub fn hash_event(previous_hash: &[u8; 32], event_bytes: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
    hasher.update(previous_hash);
    hasher.update((event_bytes.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());
    hasher.update(event_bytes);
    hasher.finalize().into()
}

/// Verify a sequence without parsing or reserializing the data.
pub fn verify_chain<'a>(
    genesis_hash: [u8; 32],
    events: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a [u8]>,
    expected_head: [u8; 32],
) -> bool {
    let mut current = genesis_hash;
    for event in events {
        current = hash_event(&current, event);
    }
    current == expected_head
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum LedgerError {
    Sqlite(rusqlite::Error),
    Io(io::Error),
    WriterLocked,
    UnsupportedSchema(i64),
    InvalidSize(usize),
    Configuration(&'static str),
    Integrity { sequence: u64, reason: &'static str },
}

impl fmt::Display for LedgerError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Sqlite(err) => write!(f, "sqlite: {err}"),
            Self::Io(err) => write!(f, "io: {err}"),
            Self::WriterLocked => write!(f, "another Executor already owns this writer lock"),
            Self::UnsupportedSchema(v) => write!(f, "unsupported ledger schema version {v}"),
            Self::InvalidSize(n) => write!(f, "invalid event length {n}"),
            Self::Configuration(why) => write!(f, "unsafe ledger configuration: {why}"),
            Self::Integrity { sequence, reason } => {
                write!(f, "ledger integrity failure at sequence {sequence}: {reason}")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Error for LedgerError {}

impl From<rusqlite::Error> for LedgerError {
    fn from(err: rusqlite::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Sqlite(err)
    }
}

impl From<io::Error> for LedgerError {
    fn from(err: io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Io(err)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct LedgerEntry {
    pub sequence: u64,
    pub event_bytes: Vec<u8>,
    pub previous_hash: [u8; 32],
    pub event_hash: [u8; 32],
}

/// Single-writer API with a process-lifetime advisory lock. The service ACLs
/// remain the authoritative access boundary once the Windows host is built.
pub struct Ledger {
    conn: Connection,
    _writer_lock: File,
    sequence: u64,
    head_hash: [u8; 32],
}

fn lock_path(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut name = path.as_os_str().to_os_string();
    name.push(".writer.lock");
    PathBuf::from(name)
}

fn checked_hash(bytes: Vec<u8>, sequence: u64) -> Result<[u8; 32], LedgerError> {
    bytes.try_into().map_err(|_| LedgerError::Integrity {
        sequence,
        reason: "hash is not 32 bytes",
    })
}

fn load_verified(
    conn: &Connection,
    after_sequence: u64,
) -> Result<(u64, [u8; 32], Vec<LedgerEntry>), LedgerError> {
    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
        "SELECT sequence,event_bytes,previous_hash,event_hash FROM ledger_events ORDER BY sequence",
    )?;
    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;
    let mut sequence = 0_u64;
    let mut previous = GENESIS;
    let mut visible = Vec::new();
    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {
        let raw_sequence: i64 = row.get(0)?;
        let expected = sequence.checked_add(1).ok_or(LedgerError::Configuration("sequence exhausted"))?;
        if raw_sequence < 1 || raw_sequence as u64 != expected {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: expected, reason: "missing or out-of-order sequence" });
        }
        let event_bytes: Vec<u8> = row.get(1)?;
        if event_bytes.is_empty() || event_bytes.len() > MAX_EVENT_BYTES {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: expected, reason: "invalid event length" });
        }
        let prev_hash = checked_hash(row.get(2)?, expected)?;
        let event_hash = checked_hash(row.get(3)?, expected)?;
        if prev_hash != previous {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: expected, reason: "broken previous hash" });
        }
        if hash_event(&previous, &event_bytes) != event_hash {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: expected, reason: "stored-byte hash mismatch" });
        }
        if expected > after_sequence {
            visible.push(LedgerEntry { sequence: expected, event_bytes, previous_hash: prev_hash, event_hash });
        }
        previous = event_hash;
        sequence = expected;
    }
    Ok((sequence, previous, visible))
}

impl Ledger {
    /// Open only with WAL and synchronous=FULL. A corrupted or future-version
    /// ledger fails closed before any append is possible.
    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<Self, LedgerError> {
        let path = path.as_ref();
        let lock = OpenOptions::new().create(true).read(true).write(true).open(lock_path(path))?;
        if let Err(err) = lock.try_lock_exclusive() {
            return Err(if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
                || err.raw_os_error() == fs2::lock_contended_error().raw_os_error()
            {
                LedgerError::WriterLocked
            } else {
                LedgerError::Io(err)
            });
        }
        let mut conn = Connection::open(path)?;
        conn.busy_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))?;
        let mode: String = conn.query_row("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        if !mode.eq_ignore_ascii_case("wal") {
            return Err(LedgerError::Configuration("WAL mode unavailable"));
        }
        conn.execute_batch("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")?;
        let sync: i64 = conn.query_row("PRAGMA synchronous", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        if sync != 2 {
            return Err(LedgerError::Configuration("synchronous=FULL was not applied"));
        }
        let version: i64 = conn.query_row("PRAGMA user_version", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        match version {
            0 => {
                let tx = conn.transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate)?;
                tx.execute_batch(include_str!("../schema.sql"))?;
                tx.commit()?;
            }
            SCHEMA_VERSION => {}
            unknown => return Err(LedgerError::UnsupportedSchema(unknown)),
        }
        let trigger_count: i64 = conn.query_row(
            concat!(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger' AND ",
                "name IN ('ledger_events_no_update', 'ledger_events_no_delete')"
            ),
            [], |r| r.get(0),
        )?;
        if trigger_count != 2 {
            return Err(LedgerError::Configuration("append-only guards missing"));
        }
        let (sequence, head_hash, _) = load_verified(&conn, u64::MAX)?;
        Ok(Self { conn, _writer_lock: lock, sequence, head_hash })
    }

    /// Commit raw, already validated event bytes before returning an identity.
    /// No venue action may be attempted if this returns an error.
    pub fn append(&mut self, event_bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<LedgerEntry, LedgerError> {
        if event_bytes.is_empty() || event_bytes.len() > MAX_EVENT_BYTES {
            return Err(LedgerError::InvalidSize(event_bytes.len()));
        }
        let tx = self.conn.transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate)?;
        let current: Option<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = tx.query_row(
            "SELECT sequence,event_hash FROM ledger_events ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1",
            [], |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)),
        ).optional()?;
        let consistent = match current {
            None => self.sequence == 0 && self.head_hash == GENESIS,
            Some((seq, hash)) => seq >= 1 && seq as u64 == self.sequence
                && checked_hash(hash, self.sequence)? == self.head_hash,
        };
        if !consistent {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: self.sequence + 1, reason: "head changed outside writer" });
        }
        let sequence = self.sequence.checked_add(1).ok_or(LedgerError::Configuration("sequence exhausted"))?;
        let sequence_i64 = i64::try_from(sequence).map_err(|_| LedgerError::Configuration("sequence exhausted"))?;
        let previous_hash = self.head_hash;
        let event_hash = hash_event(&previous_hash, event_bytes);
        tx.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ledger_events(sequence,event_bytes,previous_hash,event_hash) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4)",
            params![sequence_i64, event_bytes, previous_hash.as_slice(), event_hash.as_slice()],
        )?;
        tx.commit()?;
        self.sequence = sequence;
        self.head_hash = event_hash;
        Ok(LedgerEntry { sequence, event_bytes: event_bytes.to_vec(), previous_hash, event_hash })
    }

    /// Verify the entire chain, also detecting changes to the head while open.
    pub fn verify(&self) -> Result<[u8; 32], LedgerError> {
        let (sequence, head, _) = load_verified(&self.conn, u64::MAX)?;
        if sequence != self.sequence || head != self.head_hash {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: self.sequence + 1, reason: "head changed outside writer" });
        }
        Ok(head)
    }

    /// Read a verified, strictly ordered suffix for one-way projections.
    pub fn replay_from(&self, after_sequence: u64) -> Result<Vec<LedgerEntry>, LedgerError> {
        let (sequence, head, events) = load_verified(&self.conn, after_sequence)?;
        if sequence != self.sequence || head != self.head_hash {
            return Err(LedgerError::Integrity { sequence: self.sequence + 1, reason: "head changed outside writer" });
        }
        Ok(events)
    }

    /// Diagnostic mode values; callers may not lower these settings.
    pub fn pragmas(&self) -> Result<(String, i64), LedgerError> {
        let mode = self.conn.query_row("PRAGMA journal_mode", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        let sync = self.conn.query_row("PRAGMA synchronous", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        Ok((mode, sync))
    }
}

use exec_store::{Ledger, LedgerError, MAX_EVENT_BYTES};
use rusqlite::Connection;
use tempfile::tempdir;

#[test]
fn committed_events_survive_reopen_with_exact_bytes_and_order() {
    let dir = tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = dir.path().join("exec_ledger.db");
    let event = include_bytes!("../../../contracts/v1/fixtures/genesis-event.json");
    let first_hash;
    {
        let mut ledger = Ledger::open(&path).unwrap();
        let (journal, sync): (String, i64) = ledger.pragmas().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(journal.to_lowercase(), "wal");
        assert_eq!(sync, 2, "money ledger commits require synchronous=FULL");

        let first = ledger.append(event).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first.sequence, 1);
        assert_eq!(first.previous_hash, [0; 32]);
        assert_eq!(first.event_bytes.as_slice(), event.as_slice());
        first_hash = first.event_hash;

        let second = ledger.append(br#"{"event_type":"MARK"}"#).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(second.sequence, 2);
        assert_eq!(second.previous_hash, first_hash);
    }
    let ledger = Ledger::open(&path).unwrap();
    let entries = ledger.replay_from(0).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(entries.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(entries[0].event_bytes.as_slice(), event.as_slice());
    assert_eq!(entries[1].previous_hash, first_hash);
    assert_eq!(ledger.replay_from(1).unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(ledger.verify().unwrap(), entries[1].event_hash);
}

}

-- Applied only to an empty v0 database under a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction.
-- All records are opaque, immutable stored bytes; API-level contract validation
-- belongs to the versioned ingestion boundary, not to SQLite JSON re-encoding.
CREATE TABLE ledger_events (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(sequence >= 1),
    event_bytes BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(event_bytes)='blob' AND length(event_bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
    previous_hash BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(previous_hash)='blob' AND length(previous_hash)=32),
    event_hash BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(event_hash)='blob' AND length(event_hash)=32)
);

BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger events are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger events are immutable');

//! B2 chaos-suite report: runs every seeded Fake Venue fixture and writes JSON.
//! Usage: gym-chaos OUT.json [SEEDS]. Exit 1 if any invariant is violated.
use exec_core::fake_venue::{run, Outcome, FIXTURES};

fn q(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut o = String::from('"');
    for ch in s.chars() {
        match ch {
            '"' => o.push_str("\\\""),
            '\\' => o.push_str("\\\\"),
            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => o.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32)),
            c => o.push(c),
        }
    }
    o.push('"');
    o
}

fn outcome(o: &Outcome) -> String {
    let list = |v: &[String]| v.iter().map(|s| q(s)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    format!(
        "{{\"seed\":{},\"funded_post_count\":{},\"venue_orders\":{},\"venue_filled\":{},\"recognized_filled\":{},\"lifecycle\":{},\"effect\":{},\"settlement\":{},\"reservation_released\":{},\"frozen\":{},\"incident\":{},\"trace\":[{}],\"violations\":[{}]}}",
        o.seed, o.funded_post_count, o.venue_orders, o.venue_filled, o.recognized_filled,
        q(&format!("{:?}", o.lifecycle)), q(&format!("{:?}", o.effect)), q(&format!("{:?}", o.settlement)),
        o.reservation_released, o.frozen, o.incident.map(q).unwrap_or("null".into()),
        list(&o.trace), list(&o.violations))
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let Some(out) = args.get(1) else {
        eprintln!("usage: gym-chaos OUT.json [SEEDS]");
        std::process::exit(2);
    };
    let seeds: u64 = match args.get(2).map(|s| s.parse()) {
        None => 500,
        Some(Ok(n)) if (1..=100_000).contains(&n) => n,
        _ => { eprintln!("SEEDS must be 1..=100000"); std::process::exit(2); }
    };
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    let mut total_violations = 0usize;
    for f in FIXTURES {
        let (mut settled, mut frozen, mut violations) = (0u64, 0u64, 0usize);
        let mut incidents: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
        let mut first_violation: Option<Outcome> = None;
        for seed in 1..=seeds {
            let o = run(f, seed);
            if o.reservation_released { settled += 1 }
            if o.frozen { frozen += 1 }
            if let Some(i) = o.incident { if !incidents.contains(&i) { incidents.push(i) } }
            if !o.violations.is_empty() {
                violations += o.violations.len();
                first_violation.get_or_insert(o);
            }
        }
        total_violations += violations;
        let example = first_violation.unwrap_or_else(|| run(f, 717));
        rows.push(format!(
            "{{\"fixture\":{},\"runs\":{},\"settled\":{},\"frozen\":{},\"violations\":{},\"incidents\":[{}],\"example\":{}}}",
            q(f), seeds, settled, frozen, violations,
            incidents.iter().map(|s| q(s)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","), outcome(&example)));
    }
    let json = format!(
        "{{\"report\":\"b2-chaos-suite\",\"engine\":\"exec-core fake_venue/1\",\"seeds_per_fixture\":{},\"invariants\":[\"no POST before durable intent\",\"at most one venue order per intent\",\"no resend after first byte\",\"recognized fills never exceed venue fills\",\"settle only on exact venue truth\",\"per-currency conservation\",\"unresolved keeps slot+reservation frozen with incident\"],\"passed\":{},\"total_violations\":{},\"funded_authority\":false,\"fixtures\":[{}]}}\n",
        seeds, total_violations == 0, total_violations, rows.join(","));
    if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(out, json) {
        eprintln!("cannot write report: {e}");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }
    println!("{} fixtures x {seeds} seeds, {total_violations} violations -> {out}", FIXTURES.len());
    if total_violations != 0 { std::process::exit(1) }
}

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\executor\exec-svc\src\bin\gym-stopctl.rs ===
//! Local stop-only Windows client, with correlated acknowledgment and deadline.
#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn main() {
    eprintln!("gym-stopctl requires Windows");
    std::process::exit(2);
}
#[cfg(windows)]
fn main() {
    if let Err(message) = client::run() {
        eprintln!("UNACKNOWLEDGED: {message}. Verify protection manually.");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }
}
#[cfg(windows)]
mod client {
    use exec_ipc::{StopCommand, StopReply, StopRequest, StopResult, FRAME_SIZE};
    use std::fs::File;
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    use std::os::windows::io::FromRawHandle;
    use std::ptr;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Storage::FileSystem::CreateFileW;
    use std::sync::mpsc;
    use std::thread;
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

    const PIPE: &str = r"\\.\pipe\TradingGYM.Stop.v1";

    fn correlation() -> [u8; 16] {
        let nanos = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|t| t.as_nanos()).unwrap_or(0);
        (nanos ^ ((u128::from(std::process::id())) << 64)).to_be_bytes()
    }

    fn exchange(request: StopRequest, budget: Duration) -> Result<StopReply, String> {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        thread::spawn(move || {
            let result = (|| -> Result<StopReply, String> {
                let frame = request.encode().map_err(|_| "invalid stop frame".to_owned())?;
                let wide: Vec<u16> = PIPE.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
                // Ask only for READ_DATA | WRITE_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE. Generic
                // WRITE also requests FILE_APPEND_DATA (0x4), which on named
                // pipes grants FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE and must be denied.
                let raw = unsafe {
                    CreateFileW(
                        // Identification-only SQOS prevents the service from impersonating
                        // the operator token while retaining the precise access mask.
                        wide.as_ptr(), 0x00100003, 0, ptr::null(), 3, 0x00110000, ptr::null_mut(),
                    )
                };
                if raw == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
                    // Precise native error is needed to distinguish DACL denial
                    // from pipe absence, busy instances, or name mismatch.
                    let error = std::io::Error::last_os_error();
                    return Err(format!(
                        "stop pipe open failed (Win32={}): {}",
                        error.raw_os_error().unwrap_or(-1), error
                    ));
                }
                let mut pipe = unsafe { File::from_raw_handle(raw.cast()) };
                pipe.write_all(&frame).map_err(|_| "stop request not delivered".to_owned())?;
                let mut response = [0u8; FRAME_SIZE];
                pipe.read_exact(&mut response).map_err(|_| "missing stop acknowledgment".to_owned())?;
                StopReply::decode(&response).map_err(|_| "malformed stop acknowledgment".to_owned())
            })();
            let _ = tx.send(result);
        });
        rx.recv_timeout(budget)
            .map_err(|_| "stop response timed out".to_owned())?
    }

    pub fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
        let command = match args.next().as_deref() {
            Some("status") => StopCommand::Status,
            Some("pause") => StopCommand::PauseEntries,
            Some("exit-only") => StopCommand::ExitOnly,
            Some("halt") => StopCommand::Halt,
            _ => return Err("expected status|pause|exit-only|halt".to_owned()),
        };
        if args.next().is_some() { return Err("unexpected argument".to_owned()); }
        let started = Instant::now();
        // STATUS may answer StaleRuntime with the current epoch; this is
        // discovery, never a successful stop acknowledgment.
        let initial = StopRequest {
            command: StopCommand::Status, runtime_epoch: 1, correlation: correlation(),
        };
        let status = exchange(initial, Duration::from_millis(900))?;
        if status.correlation != initial.correlation
            || status.runtime_epoch == 0
            || !matches!(status.result, StopResult::Ack | StopResult::StaleRuntime)
        {
            return Err("untrusted runtime status".to_owned());
        }
        let remaining = Duration::from_millis(900).saturating_sub(started.elapsed());
        if remaining.is_zero() { return Err("stop budget expired".to_owned()); }
        let request = StopRequest {
            command, runtime_epoch: status.runtime_epoch, correlation: correlation(),
        };
        let reply = exchange(request, remaining)?;
        if !reply.confirms(request) {
            return Err("stop request not acknowledged".to_owned());
        }
        println!("ACKNOWLEDGED: {:?} runtime={} mode={:?}",
            command, reply.runtime_epoch, reply.mode);
        Ok(())
    }
}

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\executor\exec-svc\src\lib.rs ===
//! Stop control is outside the money loop: an atomic, monotone gate with
//! independent request validation. No venue execution or credential handling.
use exec_ipc::{ProtocolError, StopCommand, StopMode, StopReply, StopRequest, StopResult, FRAME_SIZE};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering};

/// The LocalService primary user is required but is not sufficient by itself.
/// The SCM host also checks its restricted service-SID membership at runtime.
pub fn is_local_service_sid(sid: &str) -> bool {
    sid == "S-1-5-19"
}

/// A SID from the *OS process token*, not an IPC or configuration claim.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct TokenGroup {
    pub sid: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
}

/// A disabled service SID or an unrestricted service token is not sufficient.
/// `service_sid` must come from Windows LookupAccountNameW for the fixed SCM
/// service name; both SID lists must be retrieved from the actual process token.
pub fn is_restricted_executor_token(
    user_sid: &str,
    service_sid: &str,
    groups: &[TokenGroup],
    restricting_sids: &[String],
) -> bool {
    let suffix = match service_sid.strip_prefix("S-1-5-80-") {
        Some(suffix) => suffix,
        None => return false,
    };
    let pieces: Vec<_> = suffix.split('-').collect();
    if !is_local_service_sid(user_sid)
        || pieces.len() != 5
        || pieces.iter().any(|piece| {
            piece.is_empty()
                || !piece.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
                || piece.parse::<u32>().is_err()
        })
    {
        return false;
    }
    groups.iter().any(|group| group.enabled && group.sid == service_sid)
        && restricting_sids.iter().any(|sid| sid == service_sid)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub mod windows_identity;

#[cfg(windows)]
pub mod windows_pipe;

pub struct StopGate {
    runtime_epoch: u64,
    mode: AtomicU8,
}

impl StopGate {
    pub fn new(runtime_epoch: u64) -> Result<Self, ProtocolError> {
        if runtime_epoch == 0 {
            return Err(ProtocolError::InvalidIdentity);
        }
        Ok(Self { runtime_epoch, mode: AtomicU8::new(StopMode::Disarmed as u8) })
    }

    pub fn mode(&self) -> StopMode {
        self.mode.load(Ordering::SeqCst).try_into().expect("mode only stored by StopGate")
    }

    pub fn runtime_epoch(&self) -> u64 {
        self.runtime_epoch
    }

    /// Linearizable stop: HALT wins over every weaker concurrent request.
    /// This flag must be read before every future venue effect.
    pub fn process(&self, request: StopRequest) -> StopReply {
        let (result, changed) = if request.runtime_epoch != self.runtime_epoch {
            (StopResult::StaleRuntime, false)
        } else {
            match request.command {
                StopCommand::Status => (StopResult::Ack, false),
                command => {
                    let target = match command {
                        StopCommand::PauseEntries => StopMode::Paused as u8,
                        StopCommand::ExitOnly => StopMode::ExitOnly as u8,
                        StopCommand::Halt => StopMode::Halted as u8,
                        StopCommand::Status => unreachable!(),
                    };
                    let old = self.mode.fetch_max(target, Ordering::SeqCst);
                    (StopResult::Ack, old < target)
                }
            }
        };
        StopReply {
            result,
            mode: self.mode(),
            changed,
            runtime_epoch: self.runtime_epoch,
            correlation: request.correlation,
        }
    }

    pub fn process_frame(&self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<[u8; FRAME_SIZE], ProtocolError> {
        let request = StopRequest::decode(bytes)?;
        self.process(request).encode()
    }
}

/// Durably replayed, offline-only B2 intents; never grants money authority.
pub mod offline_recovery;

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\executor\exec-svc\src\main.rs ===
//! Disarmed Windows service with independent stop-only T0 listener.
//! This controls only the monotone in-memory gate; NO orders, keys or exits.
#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn main() {
    eprintln!("gym-executor is available only as a Windows service");
    std::process::exit(2);
}
#[cfg(windows)]
fn main() -> windows_service::Result<()> { windows_host::start() }

#[cfg(windows)]
mod windows_host {
    use std::ffi::OsString;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{mpsc, Arc};
    use std::thread;
    use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    use windows_service::define_windows_service;
    use windows_service::service::{
        ServiceControl, ServiceControlAccept, ServiceExitCode,
        ServiceState, ServiceStatus, ServiceType,
    };
    use windows_service::service_control_handler::{self, ServiceControlHandlerResult};
    use windows_service::service_dispatcher;
    const NAME: &str = "TradingGYMExecutor";
    define_windows_service!(ffi_service_main, service_main);

    pub(super) fn start() -> windows_service::Result<()> {
        service_dispatcher::start(NAME, ffi_service_main)
    }
    fn service_main(_args: Vec<OsString>) { let _ = run_service(); }

    fn status(state: ServiceState, code: u32) -> ServiceStatus {
        ServiceStatus {
            service_type: ServiceType::OWN_PROCESS,
            current_state: state,
            controls_accepted: if state == ServiceState::Running {
                ServiceControlAccept::STOP
            } else { ServiceControlAccept::empty() },
            exit_code: ServiceExitCode::Win32(code),
            checkpoint: 0,
            wait_hint: Duration::default(),
            process_id: None,
        }
    }

    /// The elevated installer binds a single OS-issued operator *logon* SID.
    /// The protected file cannot be supplied by a regular pipe caller.
    fn provisioned_logon_sid() -> std::io::Result<String> {
        let root = std::env::var_os("ProgramFiles").ok_or_else(|| {
            std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "missing ProgramData")
        })?;
        let file = PathBuf::from(root).join("TradingGYM").join("Executor")
            .join("stop-logon.sid");
        let info = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&file)?;
        if !info.file_type().is_file() || info.file_type().is_symlink() || info.len() > 120 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "untrusted stop SID configuration"));
        }
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(file)?;
        let sid = text.trim();
        let components: Vec<&str> = sid.split('-').collect();
        if !sid.starts_with("S-1-5-5-") || components.len() != 6
            || components[4..].iter().any(|x| x.is_empty() || !x.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()))
        {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "invalid provisioned logon SID"));
        }
        Ok(sid.to_owned())
    }

    /// Operator user identity is separately provisioned from a trusted OS
    /// process token, never copied from a client request or environment value.
    fn provisioned_user_sid() -> std::io::Result<String> {
        let root = std::env::var_os("ProgramFiles").ok_or_else(|| {
            std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "missing ProgramFiles")
        })?;
        let file = PathBuf::from(root).join("TradingGYM").join("Executor")
            .join("stop-user.sid");
        let info = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&file)?;
        if !info.file_type().is_file() || info.file_type().is_symlink() || info.len() > 120 {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "untrusted operator user SID configuration"));
        }
        let value = std::fs::read_to_string(file)?;
        let sid = value.trim();
        let components: Vec<&str> = sid.split('-').collect();
        if !sid.starts_with("S-1-") || !(5..=16).contains(&components.len())
            || components.iter().skip(1).any(|x| x.is_empty()
                || !x.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()))
        {
            return Err(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "invalid provisioned operator user SID"));
        }
        Ok(sid.to_owned())
    }

    fn run_service() -> windows_service::Result<()> {
        let should_stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let callback_stop = Arc::clone(&should_stop);
        let handler = move |event| match event {
            ServiceControl::Stop => {
                callback_stop.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                ServiceControlHandlerResult::NoError
            }
            ServiceControl::Interrogate => ServiceControlHandlerResult::NoError,
            _ => ServiceControlHandlerResult::NotImplemented,
        };
        let status_handle = service_control_handler::register(NAME, handler)?;
        if !exec_svc::windows_identity::is_restricted_executor_service() {
            status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
            return Ok(());
        }
        let service_sid = match exec_svc::windows_identity::executor_service_sid_from_os() {
            Ok(sid) => sid,
            Err(_) => {
                status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let logon_sid = match provisioned_logon_sid() {
            Ok(sid) if exec_svc::windows_pipe::stop_pipe_sddl(&service_sid, &sid).is_ok() => sid,
            _ => {
                status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let operator_user = match provisioned_user_sid() {
            Ok(sid) => sid,
            Err(_) => {
                status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let epoch = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|t| t.as_nanos() as u64).unwrap_or(0);
        let gate = match exec_svc::StopGate::new(epoch) {
            Ok(gate) => Arc::new(gate),
            Err(_) => {
                status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let (ready_tx, ready_rx) = mpsc::channel();
        let listener_failed = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
        let failed = Arc::clone(&listener_failed);
        let stop_on_failure = Arc::clone(&should_stop);
        // This independent T0 thread never waits for Python, UI or the main
        // proposal/reconciliation loop and cannot gain funded permissions.
        thread::spawn(move || {
            let result = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
                .enable_all().build()
                .map_err(std::io::Error::other)
                .and_then(|rt| rt.block_on(exec_svc::windows_pipe::serve_stop_only(
                    gate, &service_sid, &logon_sid, &operator_user, Some(ready_tx),
                )));
            if result.is_err() {
                failed.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
                stop_on_failure.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
            }
        });
        if ready_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)).is_err()
            || listener_failed.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
            || should_stop.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
        {
            status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, 5))?;
            return Ok(());
        }
        // SCM RUNNING means the stop pipe exists, NOT exit protection.
        status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Running, 0))?;
        while !should_stop.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
        }
        status_handle.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped,
            if listener_failed.load(Ordering::SeqCst) { 5 } else { 0 }))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

//! B2 offline, durably logged order identity and evidence projection.
//! No transport or funded authority: restarting this journal never submits an order.
//! All records are appended to exec-store's FULL-synchronous hash-chained ledger
//! before an Attempt projection changes. Unknown bytes or illegal replay fail closed.
use exec_core::orders::{
    Attempt, BalanceSnapshot, Event, FailureStage, OrderError,
    ReservationBook, ReservationError, SettlementEvidence,
};
use exec_store::{Ledger, LedgerError};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::Path;

const MAGIC: &[u8; 5] = b"TGOR1";
const CREATE: u8 = 1;
const EVIDENCE: u8 = 2;
const HOLD: u8 = 3;
const RELEASE_DENIED: u8 = 4;
const RELEASE_SETTLED: u8 = 5;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum RecoveryError {
    Ledger(LedgerError),
    InvalidIdentity,
    DuplicateIdentity,
    UnknownIdentity,
    MalformedEvent,
    Order(OrderError),
    Reservation(ReservationError),
}
impl PartialEq for RecoveryError {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        use RecoveryError::*;
        match (self, other) {
            (InvalidIdentity, InvalidIdentity)
            | (DuplicateIdentity, DuplicateIdentity)
            | (UnknownIdentity, UnknownIdentity)
            | (MalformedEvent, MalformedEvent) => true,
            (Order(a), Order(b)) => a == b,
            (Reservation(a), Reservation(b)) => a == b,
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}
impl From<LedgerError> for RecoveryError {
    fn from(e: LedgerError) -> Self { Self::Ledger(e) }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ObservedIntent {
    pub account: String,
    pub asset: String,
    pub attempt: Attempt,
}
pub struct DurableOrderJournal {
    ledger: Ledger,
    intents: BTreeMap<String, ObservedIntent>,
    reservations: ReservationBook,
    records: usize,
    /// A request already in flight when the journal was reopened cannot be
    /// certified as never sent by this newly started process.
    recovered_inflight: BTreeSet<String>,
}
enum Record {
    Open { id: String, account: String, asset: String, quantity: u64 },
    Observation { id: String, event: Event },
    Hold { id: String, account: String, asset: String, quanta: u64, available: u64, sequence: u64 },
    ReleaseDenied { id: String },
    ReleaseSettled { id: String, account: String, asset: String,
        sequence: u64, complete: bool, locked: u64, spent: u64, available: u64 },
}
fn valid_name(s: &str) -> bool {
    !s.is_empty() && s.len() <= 96 &&
        s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, b'-' | b'_' | b':' | b'.'))
}
fn add_name(data: &mut Vec<u8>, name: &str) -> Result<(), RecoveryError> {
    if !valid_name(name) { return Err(RecoveryError::InvalidIdentity); }
    data.push(u8::try_from(name.len()).map_err(|_| RecoveryError::InvalidIdentity)?);
    data.extend_from_slice(name.as_bytes());
    Ok(())
}
fn record_intent(id: &str, account: &str, asset: &str, quantity: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>, RecoveryError> {
    if quantity == 0 { return Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::InvalidQuantity)); }
    let mut data = MAGIC.to_vec();
    data.push(CREATE);
    add_name(&mut data, id)?;
    add_name(&mut data, account)?;
    add_name(&mut data, asset)?;
    data.extend_from_slice(&quantity.to_be_bytes());
    Ok(data)
}
fn record_event(id: &str, event: Event) -> Result<Vec<u8>, RecoveryError> {
    let mut data = MAGIC.to_vec();
    data.push(EVIDENCE);
    add_name(&mut data, id)?;
    use Event::*;
    let tag = match event {
        BeginSend => 1, TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte) => 2,
        TransportFailed(FailureStage::AfterFirstByte) => 3, Acknowledged => 4,
        Working => 5, MissingFromList => 6, CumulativeFilled(_) => 7,
        TerminalReported => 8, SettlementVerified => 9, Denied => 10,
        VenueRejected => 11, SettlementAnomaly => 12, AnomalyReconciled { .. } => 13,
    };
    data.push(tag);
    match event {
        CumulativeFilled(n) => data.extend_from_slice(&n.to_be_bytes()),
        AnomalyReconciled { expected_available_quanta, observed_available_quanta } => {
            data.extend_from_slice(&expected_available_quanta.to_be_bytes());
            data.extend_from_slice(&observed_available_quanta.to_be_bytes());
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    Ok(data)
}
// Every reservation change is part of the SAME durable ledger as the
// attempt, not a second database that could commit or fail independently.
fn record_hold(id: &str, snapshot: &BalanceSnapshot, quanta: u64)
    -> Result<Vec<u8>, RecoveryError>
{
    let mut data = MAGIC.to_vec();
    data.push(HOLD);
    add_name(&mut data, id)?;
    add_name(&mut data, &snapshot.account)?;
    add_name(&mut data, &snapshot.asset)?;
    for value in [quanta, snapshot.available_quanta, snapshot.sequence] {
        data.extend_from_slice(&value.to_be_bytes());
    }
    Ok(data)
}
fn record_release_denied(id: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, RecoveryError> {
    let mut data = MAGIC.to_vec();
    data.push(RELEASE_DENIED);
    add_name(&mut data, id)?;
    Ok(data)
}
fn record_release_settled(id: &str, evidence: &SettlementEvidence)
    -> Result<Vec<u8>, RecoveryError>
{
    let mut data = MAGIC.to_vec();
    data.push(RELEASE_SETTLED);
    add_name(&mut data, id)?;
    add_name(&mut data, &evidence.account)?;
    add_name(&mut data, &evidence.asset)?;
    data.extend_from_slice(&evidence.sequence.to_be_bytes());
    data.push(u8::from(evidence.complete));
    for value in [evidence.locked_quanta, evidence.spent_quanta, evidence.available_quanta] {
        data.extend_from_slice(&value.to_be_bytes());
    }
    Ok(data)
}

struct Reader<'a> { bytes: &'a [u8], pos: usize }
impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    fn take(&mut self, len: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8], RecoveryError> {
        let end = self.pos.checked_add(len).ok_or(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent)?;
        let part = self.bytes.get(self.pos..end).ok_or(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent)?;
        self.pos = end;
        Ok(part)
    }
    fn one(&mut self) -> Result<u8, RecoveryError> { Ok(self.take(1)?[0]) }
    fn num(&mut self) -> Result<u64, RecoveryError> {
        let bytes: [u8; 8] = self.take(8)?.try_into().map_err(|_| RecoveryError::MalformedEvent)?;
        Ok(u64::from_be_bytes(bytes))
    }
    fn name(&mut self) -> Result<String, RecoveryError> {
        let len = self.one()? as usize;
        let bytes = self.take(len)?;
        let name = std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| RecoveryError::MalformedEvent)?;
        if !valid_name(name) { return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent); }
        Ok(name.to_owned())
    }
}
fn decode(raw: &[u8]) -> Result<Record, RecoveryError> {
    let mut r = Reader { bytes: raw, pos: 0 };
    if r.take(MAGIC.len())? != MAGIC { return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent); }
    let kind = r.one()?;
    let id = r.name()?;
    let rec = match kind {
        CREATE => {
            let account = r.name()?;
            let asset = r.name()?;
            let quantity = r.num()?;
            if quantity == 0 { return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent); }
            Record::Open { id, account, asset, quantity }
        }
        EVIDENCE => {
            use Event::*;
            let event = match r.one()? {
                1 => BeginSend, 2 => TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte),
                3 => TransportFailed(FailureStage::AfterFirstByte),
                4 => Acknowledged, 5 => Working, 6 => MissingFromList,
                7 => CumulativeFilled(r.num()?), 8 => TerminalReported,
                9 => SettlementVerified, 10 => Denied, 11 => VenueRejected,
                12 => SettlementAnomaly, 13 => AnomalyReconciled {
                    expected_available_quanta: r.num()?,
                    observed_available_quanta: r.num()?,
                },
                _ => return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent),
            };
            Record::Observation { id, event }
        }
        HOLD => Record::Hold {
            id, account: r.name()?, asset: r.name()?,
            quanta: r.num()?, available: r.num()?, sequence: r.num()?,
        },
        RELEASE_DENIED => Record::ReleaseDenied { id },
        RELEASE_SETTLED => {
            let account = r.name()?;
            let asset = r.name()?;
            let sequence = r.num()?;
            let complete = match r.one()? {
                0 => false, 1 => true,
                _ => return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent),
            };
            Record::ReleaseSettled {
                id, account, asset, sequence, complete,
                locked: r.num()?, spent: r.num()?, available: r.num()?,
            }
        }
        _ => return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent),
    };
    if r.pos != raw.len() { return Err(RecoveryError::MalformedEvent); }
    Ok(rec)
}
fn apply_record(intents: &mut BTreeMap<String, ObservedIntent>,
    reservations: &mut ReservationBook, record: Record) -> Result<(), RecoveryError>
{
    match record {
        Record::Open { id, account, asset, quantity } => {
            if intents.contains_key(&id) { return Err(RecoveryError::DuplicateIdentity); }
            intents.insert(id, ObservedIntent {
                account, asset, attempt: Attempt::new(quantity).map_err(RecoveryError::Order)?,
            });
        }
        Record::Observation { id, event } => {
            let current = intents.get_mut(&id).ok_or(RecoveryError::UnknownIdentity)?;
            current.attempt.apply(event).map_err(RecoveryError::Order)?;
        }
        Record::Hold { id, account, asset, quanta, available, sequence } => {
            let order = intents.get(&id).ok_or(RecoveryError::UnknownIdentity)?;
            if order.account != account || order.asset != asset {
                return Err(RecoveryError::Reservation(ReservationError::InvalidEvidence));
            }
            let snapshot = BalanceSnapshot::new(&account, &asset, available, sequence)
                .map_err(RecoveryError::Reservation)?;
            reservations.reserve(&id, &account, &asset, quanta, &snapshot, &order.attempt)
                .map_err(RecoveryError::Reservation)?;
        }
        Record::ReleaseDenied { id } => {
            let order = intents.get(&id).ok_or(RecoveryError::UnknownIdentity)?;
            reservations.release_denied(&id, &order.attempt)
                .map_err(RecoveryError::Reservation)?;
        }
        Record::ReleaseSettled {
            id, account, asset, sequence, complete, locked, spent, available,
        } => {
            let order = intents.get(&id).ok_or(RecoveryError::UnknownIdentity)?;
            let evidence = SettlementEvidence::new(
                &account, &asset, sequence, complete, locked, spent, available,
            ).map_err(RecoveryError::Reservation)?;
            reservations.release_settled(&id, &order.attempt, &evidence)
                .map_err(RecoveryError::Reservation)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
impl DurableOrderJournal {
    pub fn open(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<Self, RecoveryError> {
        let ledger = Ledger::open(path)?;
        let records = ledger.replay_from(0)?;
        let mut intents = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut reservations = ReservationBook::default();
        for e in &records {
            let parsed = decode(&e.event_bytes)?;
            // Verified bytes that cannot form a legal state also fail closed.
            apply_record(&mut intents, &mut reservations, parsed)
                .map_err(|_| RecoveryError::MalformedEvent)?;
        }
        let recovered_inflight = intents.iter()
            .filter(|(_, order)| order.attempt.lifecycle() == exec_core::orders::Lifecycle::Submitting)
            .map(|(id, _)| id.clone()).collect();
        Ok(Self { ledger, intents, reservations, records: records.len(), recovered_inflight })
    }

    pub fn create_intent(&mut self, id: &str, account: &str, asset: &str, quantity: u64)
        -> Result<(), RecoveryError>
    {
        if self.intents.contains_key(id) { return Err(RecoveryError::DuplicateIdentity); }
        let raw = record_intent(id, account, asset, quantity)?;
        let parsed = decode(&raw)?;
        // Verify on a copy before persisting. No in-memory or venue effect before commit.
        let mut next = self.intents.clone();
        let mut next_holds = self.reservations.clone();
        apply_record(&mut next, &mut next_holds, parsed)?;
        self.ledger.append(&raw)?;
        self.intents = next;
        self.reservations = next_holds;
        self.records += 1;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn record_event(&mut self, id: &str, event: Event) -> Result<(), RecoveryError> {
        if event == Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte)
            && self.recovered_inflight.contains(id)
        {
            return Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::IllegalTransition));
        }
        let raw = record_event(id, event)?;
        let parsed = decode(&raw)?;
        let mut next = self.intents.clone();
        let mut next_holds = self.reservations.clone();
        apply_record(&mut next, &mut next_holds, parsed)?;
        self.ledger.append(&raw)?;
        self.intents = next;
        self.reservations = next_holds;
        self.records += 1;
        Ok(())
    }
    /// Durable offline reservation admission. A snapshot is *not* trusted
    /// solely because this model accepts it: funded admission is disabled.
    pub fn reserve_intent(&mut self, id: &str, quanta: u64,
        snapshot: &BalanceSnapshot) -> Result<(), RecoveryError>
    {
        let raw = record_hold(id, snapshot, quanta)?;
        self.apply_durable(raw)
    }
    pub fn release_denied_reservation(&mut self, id: &str)
        -> Result<(), RecoveryError>
    {
        self.apply_durable(record_release_denied(id)?)
    }
    pub fn release_settled_reservation(&mut self, id: &str,
        evidence: &SettlementEvidence) -> Result<(), RecoveryError>
    {
        self.apply_durable(record_release_settled(id, evidence)?)
    }
    /// A failed transition is not appended and does not change any hold.
    fn apply_durable(&mut self, raw: Vec<u8>) -> Result<(), RecoveryError> {
        let parsed = decode(&raw)?;
        let mut next = self.intents.clone();
        let mut next_holds = self.reservations.clone();
        apply_record(&mut next, &mut next_holds, parsed)?;
        self.ledger.append(&raw)?;
        self.intents = next;
        self.reservations = next_holds;
        self.records += 1;
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn reserved(&self, account: &str, asset: &str) -> u64 {
        self.reservations.reserved(account, asset)
    }
    pub fn get(&self, id: &str) -> Option<&ObservedIntent> { self.intents.get(id) }
    pub fn pending_ids(&self) -> Vec<&str> {
        self.intents.iter().filter(|(_, record)| record.attempt.holds_slot())
            .map(|(id, _)| id.as_str()).collect()
    }
    pub fn record_count(&self) -> usize { self.records }
}

//! Restricted Windows SCM host identity preflight, using the OS process token.
//! This does not verify named-pipe ACLs, T2 principal or credential isolation.
use std::io;
use std::ptr;
use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, HANDLE, LocalFree};
use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Authorization::ConvertSidToStringSidW;
use windows_sys::Win32::Security::{GetTokenInformation, TokenUser, TOKEN_QUERY, TOKEN_USER};
use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{GetCurrentProcess, OpenProcessToken};

struct OwnedToken(HANDLE);
impl Drop for OwnedToken {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.0.is_null() {
            // SAFETY: OpenProcessToken returns a closeable process token handle.
            unsafe { CloseHandle(self.0) };
        }
    }
}

struct OwnedSidText(*mut u16);
impl Drop for OwnedSidText {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.0.is_null() {
            // SAFETY: ConvertSidToStringSidW allocates via LocalAlloc.
            unsafe { LocalFree(self.0.cast()) };
        }
    }
}

/// Probe the OS-issued primary user SID; never trust an environment variable
/// or a command-line claim of the service identity.
pub fn process_user_sid() -> io::Result<String> {
    let mut raw_handle: HANDLE = ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: valid pseudo-handle, token out-pointer, no caller-supplied memory.
    if unsafe { OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &mut raw_handle) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let token = OwnedToken(raw_handle);
    let mut size = 0_u32;
    // SAFETY: documented size-probe call; TokenUser result is variable-length.
    unsafe { GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenUser, ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut size) };
    if size < std::mem::size_of::<TOKEN_USER>() as u32 || size > 65_536 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid token user length"));
    }
    // TOKEN_USER is pointer-aligned, unlike Vec<u8>. Use pointer-sized storage.
    let word_size = std::mem::size_of::<usize>();
    let mut storage = vec![0_usize; (size as usize + word_size - 1) / word_size];
    // SAFETY: storage is aligned, sized at least 'size', token and output live.
    if unsafe {
        GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenUser, storage.as_mut_ptr().cast(), size, &mut size)
    } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    // SAFETY: validated TokenUser result begins with the expected TOKEN_USER.
    let user = unsafe { &*storage.as_ptr().cast::<TOKEN_USER>() };
    if user.User.Sid.is_null() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "null token SID"));
    }
    let mut raw_string: *mut u16 = ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: SID is contained in the live token information buffer.
    if unsafe { ConvertSidToStringSidW(user.User.Sid, &mut raw_string) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let text = OwnedSidText(raw_string);
    if text.0.is_null() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "null SID text"));
    }
    let mut count = 0_usize;
    // SAFETY: allocated UTF-16 SID string is terminated; cap defensive scan.
    while count < 256 && unsafe { *text.0.add(count) } != 0 {
        count += 1;
    }
    if count == 256 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "SID text too long"));
    }
    // SAFETY: valid UTF-16 buffer from ConvertSidToStringSidW.
    let slice = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(text.0, count) };
    String::from_utf16(slice).map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid SID text"))
}


/// Derive the fixed service SID from Windows account lookup, not from an
/// environment variable, config file, IPC message, or installer output.
pub fn executor_service_sid_from_os() -> io::Result<String> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::LookupAccountNameW;
    let name: Vec<u16> = "NT SERVICE\\TradingGYMExecutor"
        .encode_utf16()
        .chain(std::iter::once(0))
        .collect();
    let mut sid_len = 0_u32;
    let mut domain_len = 0_u32;
    let mut sid_use = 0;
    // SAFETY: documented sizing probe; both output lengths start at zero.
    let probe = unsafe {
        LookupAccountNameW(
            ptr::null(), name.as_ptr(), ptr::null_mut(), &mut sid_len,
            ptr::null_mut(), &mut domain_len, &mut sid_use,
        )
    };
    if probe != 0 || io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() != Some(122)
        || sid_len == 0 || sid_len > 1024 || domain_len > 4096
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid service SID lookup size"));
    }
    let words = (sid_len as usize + std::mem::size_of::<usize>() - 1)
        / std::mem::size_of::<usize>();
    let mut sid_memory = vec![0_usize; words];
    let mut domain = vec![0_u16; domain_len as usize];
    let domain_ptr = if domain.is_empty() { ptr::null_mut() } else { domain.as_mut_ptr() };
    // SAFETY: SID storage is aligned and sized using the OS-provided length.
    let found = unsafe {
        LookupAccountNameW(
            ptr::null(), name.as_ptr(), sid_memory.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
            &mut sid_len, domain_ptr, &mut domain_len, &mut sid_use,
        )
    };
    if found == 0 { return Err(io::Error::last_os_error()); }
    if sid_len < 8 || sid_len as usize > sid_memory.len() * std::mem::size_of::<usize>() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid service SID length"));
    }
    sid_text(sid_memory.as_mut_ptr().cast())
}

fn sid_text(sid: *mut std::ffi::c_void) -> io::Result<String> {
    if sid.is_null() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "null token group SID"));
    }
    let mut raw_string: *mut u16 = ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: SID comes from Windows token information or LookupAccountNameW.
    if unsafe { ConvertSidToStringSidW(sid, &mut raw_string) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let text = OwnedSidText(raw_string);
    if text.0.is_null() {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "null SID text"));
    }
    let mut count = 0_usize;
    while count < 256 && unsafe { *text.0.add(count) } != 0 { count += 1; }
    if count == 256 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "SID text too long"));
    }
    let slice = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(text.0, count) };
    String::from_utf16(slice).map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid SID text"))
}

fn current_token_groups(kind: windows_sys::Win32::Security::TOKEN_INFORMATION_CLASS)
    -> io::Result<Vec<super::TokenGroup>>
{
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::{SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES, TOKEN_GROUPS};
    let mut raw_handle: HANDLE = ptr::null_mut();
    if unsafe { OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &mut raw_handle) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let token = OwnedToken(raw_handle);
    let mut size = 0_u32;
    // SAFETY: sizing probe; token is a process token with TOKEN_QUERY only.
    let probe = unsafe { GetTokenInformation(token.0, kind, ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut size) };
    if probe != 0 || io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() != Some(122)
        || (size as usize) < std::mem::size_of::<TOKEN_GROUPS>()
        || size > 1_048_576
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid token groups size"));
    }
    let word = std::mem::size_of::<usize>();
    let mut aligned = vec![0_usize; (size as usize + word - 1) / word];
    let allocated = aligned.len() * word;
    // SAFETY: an aligned buffer with the OS-requested capacity.
    let ok = unsafe { GetTokenInformation(token.0, kind, aligned.as_mut_ptr().cast(), size, &mut size) };
    if ok == 0 { return Err(io::Error::last_os_error()); }
    let offset = std::mem::offset_of!(TOKEN_GROUPS, Groups);
    if (size as usize) < offset || (size as usize) > allocated {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "token groups length changed"));
    }
    let base = aligned.as_ptr().cast::<TOKEN_GROUPS>();
    // SAFETY: GetTokenInformation returned a TOKEN_GROUPS header.
    let count = unsafe { (*base).GroupCount as usize };
    let available = (size as usize - offset) / std::mem::size_of::<SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES>();
    if count > available {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "token group count exceeds buffer"));
    }
    // SAFETY: count is bounded by returned OS memory, and both structs have
    // compatible C alignment with the aligned Vec<usize> backing allocation.
    let pointer = unsafe { std::ptr::addr_of!((*base).Groups).cast::<SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES>() };
    let entries = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(pointer, count) };
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for entry in entries {
        out.push(super::TokenGroup {
            sid: sid_text(entry.Sid)?,
            enabled: (entry.Attributes & 0x4) != 0, // SE_GROUP_ENABLED
        });
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// The SCM host refuses RUNNING unless the current *OS process token* has:
/// - LocalService as its primary user;
/// - the exact service SID enabled in ordinary group membership;
/// - the same service SID in its restricting SID list.
///
/// This does not certify the operator logon SID, pipe ACL, T2, credentials,
/// private data ACLs or funded safety. It is a strictly stronger bootstrap gate.
pub fn is_restricted_executor_service() -> bool {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::{TokenGroups, TokenRestrictedSids};
    (|| -> io::Result<bool> {
        let user_sid = process_user_sid()?;
        let service_sid = executor_service_sid_from_os()?;
        let groups = current_token_groups(TokenGroups)?;
        let restricted = current_token_groups(TokenRestrictedSids)?;
        let restricting_sids = restricted.into_iter().map(|g| g.sid).collect::<Vec<_>>();
        Ok(super::is_restricted_executor_token(
            &user_sid, &service_sid, &groups, &restricting_sids,
        ))
    })().unwrap_or(false)
}


/// Query the Windows TokenUser of the currently impersonated named-pipe
/// client, never a supplied user name or group. The server must call this
/// synchronously before RevertToSelf and before applying a stop request.
pub fn impersonated_thread_user_sid() -> io::Result<String> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{GetCurrentThread, OpenThreadToken};
    let mut raw_token: HANDLE = ptr::null_mut();
    if unsafe { OpenThreadToken(GetCurrentThread(), TOKEN_QUERY, 1, &mut raw_token) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let token = OwnedToken(raw_token);
    let mut size = 0_u32;
    let probe = unsafe {
        GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenUser, ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut size)
    };
    if probe != 0 || io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() != Some(122)
        || size < std::mem::size_of::<TOKEN_USER>() as u32 || size > 65_536
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid client TokenUser size"));
    }
    let word = std::mem::size_of::<usize>();
    let mut aligned = vec![0_usize; (size as usize + word - 1) / word];
    if unsafe {
        GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenUser, aligned.as_mut_ptr().cast(), size, &mut size)
    } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    if (size as usize) < std::mem::size_of::<TOKEN_USER>() ||
        (size as usize) > aligned.len() * word
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "client TokenUser length changed"));
    }
    let user = unsafe { &*aligned.as_ptr().cast::<TOKEN_USER>() };
    sid_text(user.User.Sid)
}

/// Read the OS-issued logon SID of the currently impersonated named-pipe
/// client. This MUST be called synchronously on the same thread after the
/// server has read from that client's pipe and before RevertToSelf. Never use
/// process token or a client-supplied field as the authorized identity.
pub fn impersonated_thread_logon_sid() -> io::Result<String> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::{
        GetTokenInformation, SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES, TOKEN_GROUPS, TOKEN_QUERY,
        TokenLogonSid,
    };
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{GetCurrentThread, OpenThreadToken};

    let mut raw_token: HANDLE = ptr::null_mut();
    // OpenAsSelf=TRUE is required when the client requests identification-only
    // SQOS; otherwise opening a token while impersonating can fail.
    if unsafe { OpenThreadToken(GetCurrentThread(), TOKEN_QUERY, 1, &mut raw_token) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let token = OwnedToken(raw_token);
    let mut length = 0_u32;
    let sizing_result = unsafe {
        GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenLogonSid, ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut length)
    };
    if sizing_result != 0 || io::Error::last_os_error().raw_os_error() != Some(122)
        || length < std::mem::size_of::<TOKEN_GROUPS>() as u32 || length > 65_536
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid client logon SID size"));
    }
    // The token's SID pointers require pointer-aligned storage.
    let word = std::mem::size_of::<usize>();
    let mut storage = vec![0_usize; (length as usize + word - 1) / word];
    let allocated = storage.len() * word;
    if unsafe {
        GetTokenInformation(token.0, TokenLogonSid, storage.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
                            length, &mut length)
    } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let groups = storage.as_ptr().cast::<TOKEN_GROUPS>();
    let offset = std::mem::offset_of!(TOKEN_GROUPS, Groups);
    if (length as usize) < offset || (length as usize) > allocated {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid client token groups"));
    }
    // TokenLogonSid is a singleton OS-issued SID, not arbitrary TokenGroups.
    let count = unsafe { (*groups).GroupCount as usize };
    let capacity = (length as usize - offset) / std::mem::size_of::<SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES>();
    if count != 1 || capacity < 1 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "ambiguous client logon SID"));
    }
    let entry = unsafe { &*std::ptr::addr_of!((*groups).Groups).cast::<SID_AND_ATTRIBUTES>() };
    if (entry.Attributes & 0xC000_0000) != 0xC000_0000 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "untrusted client logon group"));
    }
    let sid = sid_text(entry.Sid)?;
    let components: Vec<&str> = sid.split('-').collect();
    if components.len() != 6 || components[..4] != ["S", "1", "5", "5"]
        || components[4..].iter().any(|part| part.is_empty()
            || !part.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()))
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "malformed client logon SID"));
    }
    Ok(sid)
}

//! Windows-only stop pipe listener. No default ACL and no remote clients.
//! Installation, restricted service identity and token/ACL self-tests are still
//! prerequisites to deployment. Call from a dedicated runtime/thread.
use crate::StopGate;
use exec_ipc::FRAME_SIZE;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::io;
use std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle;
use std::ptr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::windows::named_pipe::{NamedPipeServer, PipeMode, ServerOptions};
use tokio::sync::Semaphore;
use tokio::time::timeout;
use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::LocalFree;
use windows_sys::Win32::Security::RevertToSelf;
use windows_sys::Win32::System::Pipes::ImpersonateNamedPipeClient;
use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Authorization::ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW;
use windows_sys::Win32::Security::{PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES};

pub const STOP_PIPE_NAME: &str = r"\\.\pipe\TradingGYM.Stop.v1";
const CLIENT_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_millis(750);

fn valid_sid_parts(sid: &str) -> bool {
    sid.starts_with("S-1-5-") && sid.split('-').skip(1).all(|v| !v.is_empty() && v.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()))
}

/// Only explicitly provisioned service and operator logon SIDs are allowed.
/// An operator ACE intentionally omits FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE (0x4) and
/// WRITE_DAC. It grants FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES (0x80): Windows CreateFileW
/// requires that metadata right even with READ_DATA/WRITE_DATA/SYNCHRONIZE
/// requested. Disposable OS tests proved 0x00100003 fails, 0x00100083 opens.
/// Generic write is unsafe here because it includes pipe creation.
pub fn stop_pipe_sddl(service_sid: &str, logon_sid: &str) -> io::Result<String> {
    if !valid_sid_parts(service_sid) || !service_sid.starts_with("S-1-5-80-")
        || !valid_sid_parts(logon_sid) || !logon_sid.starts_with("S-1-5-5-")
    {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, "expected service SID and logon SID"));
    }
    Ok(format!(
        "D:P(A;;GA;;;SY)(A;;GA;;;{service_sid})(A;;0x00100083;;;{logon_sid})"
    ))
}

struct Descriptor(PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR);
impl Drop for Descriptor {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.0.is_null() {
            // SAFETY: the descriptor is returned by ConvertStringSecurityDescriptor...
            // and Windows requires exactly LocalFree to release it.
            unsafe { LocalFree(self.0.cast()) };
        }
    }
}

fn create_pipe(service_sid: &str, logon_sid: &str, first: bool) -> io::Result<NamedPipeServer> {
    let sddl = stop_pipe_sddl(service_sid, logon_sid)?;
    let wide: Vec<u16> = sddl.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
    let mut raw: PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR = ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: wide is NUL-terminated and raw is a valid out-parameter.
    let ok = unsafe {
        ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(wide.as_ptr(), 1, &mut raw, ptr::null_mut())
    };
    if ok == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let descriptor = Descriptor(raw);
    let mut attrs = SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES {
        nLength: std::mem::size_of::<SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES>() as u32,
        lpSecurityDescriptor: descriptor.0,
        bInheritHandle: 0,
    };
    let mut options = ServerOptions::new();
    options
        .pipe_mode(PipeMode::Message)
        .reject_remote_clients(true)
        .first_pipe_instance(first)
        .max_instances(64)
        .in_buffer_size(128)
        .out_buffer_size(128);
    // SAFETY: attrs and descriptor remain valid until CreateNamedPipeW returns.
    // Never use ServerOptions::create() because its default DACL is too broad.
    unsafe {
        options.create_with_security_attributes_raw(
            STOP_PIPE_NAME,
            (&mut attrs as *mut SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES).cast::<c_void>(),
        )
    }
}

/// Defense in depth: obtain the OS-issued logon SID from the actual
/// connected client's impersonated thread token. The DACL still provides the
/// first gate, but no request is applied from a different logon even if a pipe
/// access mask is unexpectedly permissive on the installed Windows host.
/// There are deliberately NO awaits during impersonation: the stop listener
/// runs on its own single-thread Tokio runtime. Revert failure is fatal.
fn verified_client_logon(client: &NamedPipeServer, expected_logon: &str, expected_user: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
    // SAFETY: the server owns this connected pipe; it has already received
    // the client's request bytes, as required by ImpersonateNamedPipeClient.
    if unsafe { ImpersonateNamedPipeClient(client.as_raw_handle()) } == 0 {
        return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
    }
    let verified_client_logon = (|| -> io::Result<()> {
        let logon = crate::windows_identity::impersonated_thread_logon_sid()?;
        let user = crate::windows_identity::impersonated_thread_user_sid()?;
        if logon != expected_logon || user != expected_user {
            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                "stop pipe client does not match provisioned OS user and logon"));
        }
        Ok(())
    })();
    // SAFETY: every successful impersonation MUST be reverted on the same
    // OS thread before any gate action or await; otherwise continuing under
    // the client's thread token is unsafe (Microsoft RevertToSelf contract).
    if unsafe { RevertToSelf() } == 0 {
        std::process::abort();
    }
    verified_client_logon
}

async fn handle_client(
    mut client: NamedPipeServer,
    gate: Arc<StopGate>,
    expected_logon: String,
    expected_user: String,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut buf = [0_u8; FRAME_SIZE + 1];
    let received = timeout(CLIENT_DEADLINE, client.read(&mut buf))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "stop request read timeout"))??;
    if received != FRAME_SIZE {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "invalid stop message size"));
    }
    verified_client_logon(&client, &expected_logon, &expected_user)?;
    let reply = gate
        .process_frame(&buf[..received])
        .map_err(|err| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, err))?;
    timeout(CLIENT_DEADLINE, client.write_all(&reply))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::TimedOut, "stop acknowledgment timeout"))??;
    Ok(())
}

/// Call on a dedicated thread/runtime, independently of future proposal or
/// reconciliation loops. Requires verified SIDs from privileged setup.
pub async fn serve_stop_only(
    gate: Arc<StopGate>,
    service_sid: &str,
    logon_sid: &str,
    user_sid: &str,
    ready: Option<std::sync::mpsc::Sender<()>>,
) -> io::Result<()> {
    let mut listening = create_pipe(service_sid, logon_sid, true)?;
    // SCM RUNNING may only follow successful secure instance creation.
    if let Some(ready) = ready { let _ = ready.send(()); }
    let slots = Arc::new(Semaphore::new(16));
    loop {
        let connect_result = listening.connect().await;
        // Retain the first instance until a replacement is available; do
        // not tear down the emergency channel after a local client abort.
        let replacement = loop {
            match create_pipe(service_sid, logon_sid, false) {
                Ok(pipe) => break pipe,
                Err(_) => tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await,
            }
        };
        let connected = std::mem::replace(&mut listening, replacement);
        if connect_result.is_err() {
            // Windows ERROR_NO_DATA (232) can occur after client disconnect.
            // This is not a reason to terminate the stop-only listener.
            continue;
        }
        if let Ok(slot) = slots.clone().try_acquire_owned() {
            let state = gate.clone();
            let operator_logon = logon_sid.to_owned();
            let operator_user = user_sid.to_owned();
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                let _slot = slot;
                let _ = handle_client(connected, state, operator_logon, operator_user).await;
            });
        }
        // At capacity, drop the connection; never queue unbounded requests.
    }
}

use exec_ipc::{StopCommand, StopMode, StopReply, StopRequest, StopResult};
use exec_svc::StopGate;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::thread;

fn request(command: StopCommand, epoch: u64) -> StopRequest {
    StopRequest { command, runtime_epoch: epoch, correlation: [3; 16] }
}

#[test]
fn boots_disarmed_and_status_never_grants_authority() {
    assert!(StopGate::new(0).is_err());
    let gate = StopGate::new(7).unwrap();
    let reply = gate.process(request(StopCommand::Status, 7));
    assert_eq!(reply.mode, StopMode::Disarmed);
    assert_eq!(reply.result, StopResult::Ack);
    assert!(!reply.changed);
}

#[test]
fn stop_commands_only_tighten_and_old_epoch_is_rejected() {
    let gate = StopGate::new(7).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(gate.process(request(StopCommand::PauseEntries, 7)).mode, StopMode::Paused);
    assert_eq!(gate.process(request(StopCommand::ExitOnly, 7)).mode, StopMode::ExitOnly);
    let weak = gate.process(request(StopCommand::PauseEntries, 7));
    assert_eq!(weak.mode, StopMode::ExitOnly);
    assert!(!weak.changed);
    let old = gate.process(request(StopCommand::Halt, 6));
    assert_eq!(old.result, StopResult::StaleRuntime);
    assert_eq!(old.runtime_epoch, 7);
    assert_eq!(old.mode, StopMode::ExitOnly);
    assert_eq!(gate.process(request(StopCommand::Halt, 7)).mode, StopMode::Halted);
    assert_eq!(gate.process(request(StopCommand::ExitOnly, 7)).mode, StopMode::Halted);
    assert_eq!(StopGate::new(8).unwrap().mode(), StopMode::Disarmed);
}

#[test]
fn invalid_framing_cannot_change_emergency_state() {
    let gate = StopGate::new(7).unwrap();
    let mut raw = request(StopCommand::Halt, 7).encode().unwrap();
    raw[12] = 9;
    assert!(gate.process_frame(&raw).is_err());
    assert_eq!(gate.mode(), StopMode::Disarmed);
    let ack = gate.process_frame(&request(StopCommand::Halt, 7).encode().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let reply = StopReply::decode(&ack).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(reply.mode, StopMode::Halted);
    assert_eq!(reply.correlation, [3; 16]);
}

#[test]
fn halt_wins_under_concurrent_stop_requests() {
    let gate = Arc::new(StopGate::new(7).unwrap());
    let mut workers = Vec::new();
    for n in 0..32 {
        let gate = gate.clone();
        workers.push(thread::spawn(move || {
            let cmd = match n % 3 {
                0 => StopCommand::Halt,
                1 => StopCommand::PauseEntries,
                _ => StopCommand::ExitOnly,
            };
            gate.process(request(cmd, 7));
        }));
    }
    for worker in workers {
        worker.join().unwrap();
    }
    assert_eq!(gate.mode(), StopMode::Halted);
}

//! Synthetic durable recovery; no transport, key access, or funded execution.
use exec_core::orders::{Event, FailureStage, Lifecycle, OrderError, Settlement};
use exec_svc::offline_recovery::{DurableOrderJournal, RecoveryError};
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

fn db_path(test: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let nonce = SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos();
    std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("tradinggym-b2-{test}-{}-{nonce}.sqlite", std::process::id()))
}

#[test]
fn recovery_never_resends_ambiguous_or_inflight_orders() {
    let path = db_path("ack-lost");
    {
        let mut journal = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
        journal.create_intent("client-a", "main", "USDT", 10).unwrap();
        journal.record_event("client-a", Event::BeginSend).unwrap();
        journal.record_event("client-a", Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::AfterFirstByte)).unwrap();
    }
    let mut restarted = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restarted.get("client-a").unwrap().attempt.lifecycle(), Lifecycle::Unknown);
    assert_eq!(restarted.record_event("client-a", Event::BeginSend),
        Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::RetryForbidden)));
    assert_eq!(restarted.pending_ids(), vec!["client-a"]);
    restarted.record_event("client-a", Event::Acknowledged).unwrap();
    restarted.record_event("client-a", Event::TerminalReported).unwrap();
    restarted.record_event("client-a", Event::CumulativeFilled(0)).unwrap();
    restarted.record_event("client-a", Event::SettlementVerified).unwrap();
    drop(restarted);
    let recovered = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered.get("client-a").unwrap().attempt.lifecycle(), Lifecycle::Closed);
    assert_eq!(recovered.get("client-a").unwrap().attempt.settlement(), Settlement::Verified);
    assert!(recovered.pending_ids().is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn crash_after_begin_send_before_dispatch_proof_is_not_retryable() {
    let path = db_path("inflight");
    {
        let mut journal = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
        journal.create_intent("client-b", "main", "BTC", 2).unwrap();
        journal.record_event("client-b", Event::BeginSend).unwrap();
    }
    let mut restarted = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restarted.get("client-b").unwrap().attempt.lifecycle(), Lifecycle::Submitting);
    assert_eq!(restarted.record_event("client-b", Event::BeginSend),
        Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::RetryForbidden)));
    assert_eq!(restarted.pending_ids(), vec!["client-b"]);
}

#[test]
fn invalid_transition_does_not_append_to_durable_ledger() {
    let path = db_path("atomic");
    let mut journal = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    journal.create_intent("client-c", "main", "USDT", 25).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(journal.record_event("client-c", Event::SettlementVerified),
        Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::IllegalTransition)));
    let before = journal.get("client-c").unwrap().attempt;
    assert_eq!(journal.create_intent("client-c", "main", "USDT", 25),
        Err(RecoveryError::DuplicateIdentity));
    drop(journal);
    let recovered = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered.get("client-c").unwrap().attempt, before);
    assert_eq!(recovered.record_count(), 1);
}

#[test]
fn recovered_inflight_attempt_cannot_claim_prebyte_failure_after_crash() {
    let path = db_path("crash-prebyte");
    {
        let mut writer = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
        writer.create_intent("client-crash", "main", "BTC", 5).unwrap();
        writer.record_event("client-crash", Event::BeginSend).unwrap();
    }
    for _ in 0..2 {
        let mut restarted = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(restarted.record_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(
            restarted.record_event("client-crash",
                Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte)),
            Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::IllegalTransition))
        );
        assert_eq!(restarted.record_count(), 2);
        assert_eq!(restarted.get("client-crash").unwrap().attempt.lifecycle(),
            Lifecycle::Submitting);
        assert_eq!(restarted.record_event("client-crash", Event::BeginSend),
            Err(RecoveryError::Order(OrderError::RetryForbidden)));
    }
    let mut restarted = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    restarted.record_event("client-crash",
        Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::AfterFirstByte)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restarted.get("client-crash").unwrap().attempt.lifecycle(),
        Lifecycle::Unknown);
}

#[test]
fn continuous_process_may_record_proven_prebyte_failure_once() {
    let path = db_path("same-process-prebyte");
    let mut writer = DurableOrderJournal::open(&path).unwrap();
    writer.create_intent("client-proven", "main", "USDT", 10).unwrap();
    writer.record_event("client-proven", Event::BeginSend).unwrap();
    writer.record_event("client-proven",
        Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte)).unwrap();
    assert!(writer.get("client-proven").unwrap().attempt.can_retry_same_identity());
    writer.record_event("client-proven", Event::BeginSend).unwrap();
    writer.record_event("client-proven",
        Event::TransportFailed(FailureStage::BeforeFirstByte)).unwrap();
    assert!(!writer.get("client-proven").unwrap().attempt.can_retry_same_identity());
}
