"""DATA-05 cross-check: internal LAST bars built from collected trades against the venue's own candles."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from ..domain.bars import BarSpec, trade_bars
from ..domain.model import iso
from .data_portal import DataPortal

HEARTBEAT_COVERAGE = timedelta(seconds=70)  # collector heartbeat is 60 s: a row this close means it was listening


def bps(a: Decimal, b: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    return abs(a - b) / b * 10000


def candle_crosscheck(portal: DataPortal, symbol: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, *,
                      resolution: str = "1min", tolerance_bps: Decimal = Decimal(10)) -> dict:
    """Per period: AGREE / DIVERGENT (any OHLC beyond tolerance) / MISSING_INTERNAL (venue traded while we
    listened, we saw nothing) / MISSING_VENUE / NOT_COVERED (collector not running). Venue candles still forming
    when fetched, and zero-volume candles (carried prices), are not compared."""
    if not start < end:
        raise ValueError("inverted or empty cross-check range")
    spec = BarSpec(resolution, "LAST")
    internal = {b.start: b for b in trade_bars(symbol, spec, portal.trades_by_event(symbol, start, end), end)}
    venue = {k["t"]: k for k in portal.venue_candles(symbol, resolution, start, end)
             if k["v"] > 0 and k["t"] + spec.step <= k["fetched_at"]}
    rows = []
    for t in sorted(set(internal) | set(venue)):
        mine, theirs = internal.get(t), venue.get(t)
        row = {"t": iso(t)}
        if mine and theirs:
            diff = {k: bps(getattr(mine, f), theirs[k])
                    for k, f in (("o", "open"), ("h", "high"), ("l", "low"), ("c", "close"))}
            worst = max(diff.values())
            row |= {"status": "AGREE" if worst <= tolerance_bps else "DIVERGENT",
                    "worst_bps": str(worst.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))),
                    "internal": [str(mine.open), str(mine.high), str(mine.low), str(mine.close), str(mine.volume)],
                    "venue": [str(theirs[k]) for k in "ohlcv"]}
        elif theirs:
            covered = portal.observed(symbol, t - HEARTBEAT_COVERAGE, t + spec.step + HEARTBEAT_COVERAGE)
            row |= {"status": "MISSING_INTERNAL" if covered else "NOT_COVERED", "venue": [str(theirs[k]) for k in "ohlcv"]}
        else:
            row |= {"status": "MISSING_VENUE", "internal": [str(mine.open), str(mine.high), str(mine.low),
                                                           str(mine.close), str(mine.volume)]}
        rows.append(row)
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        counts[row["status"]] = counts.get(row["status"], 0) + 1
    return {"symbol": symbol, "resolution": resolution, "from": iso(start), "to_exclusive": iso(end),
            "tolerance_bps": str(tolerance_bps), "counts": counts, "periods": rows,
            "limitations": ["Internal bars use venue event time. Wallex public trades have no stable trade id; identical "
                            "prints are preserved, so source retransmissions cannot be distinguished from real fills.",
                            "MISSING_VENUE can be a venue candle not yet fetched, not only a venue omission."]}

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\src\gym\services\live_paper.py ===
"""Poll the collector's local database; elapsed duration starts after strategy warmup."""
import asyncio
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from ..domain.model import iso
from ..domain.sim import CostModel
from ..domain.strategy import EmaTrend, digest
from .collector import now_utc
from ..adapters.run_store import save_run
from .data_portal import DataPortal
from .paper import session_result
from .rules import RuleService
from .session import ENGINE_VERSION, PaperSession


async def watch(db, root, symbol, duration, resolution, fast, slow, cash, demo=False, subscriptions=(),
                cost=None):
    if duration <= 0:
        raise ValueError("duration must be positive")
    start, tops = now_utc(), []
    portal, svc, cost = DataPortal(db), RuleService(db), cost or CostModel()
    session = PaperSession(portal, lambda t: svc.load(t)[1], EmaTrend(fast, slow), symbol, start, resolution, cash, cost,
                           subscriptions)
    reason = None
    print("WARMING_UP: run the collector separately; duration begins at RUNNING.", flush=True)
    try:
        while True:
            now = now_utc()
            for top in portal.tops(symbol, session.cursor, now):
                if top.ts_avail > session.cursor:
                    if session.running_at and top.ts_avail >= session.running_at + timedelta(seconds=duration) and session.state != "FINISHING":
                        session.transition("FINISHING", session.running_at + timedelta(seconds=duration))
                    session.feed(top)
                    tops.append(top)
            if session.running_at and now >= session.running_at + timedelta(seconds=duration) and session.state != "FINISHING":
                session.transition("FINISHING", session.running_at + timedelta(seconds=duration))
            if session.state != "FINISHING":
                session.scan(now)
            if session.running_at and now >= session.running_at + timedelta(seconds=duration):
                if session.state != "FINISHING":
                    session.transition("FINISHING", now)
                session.settle(None, now)
                if not session.pending:
                    break
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        reason = "Operator interrupted (Ctrl+C)"
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = f"Session error: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    finally:
        session.finish(now_utc(), reason)
        result = session_result(session, tops, cash)
        inputs = {"engine": ENGINE_VERSION, "kind": "live-session", "symbol": symbol, "from": iso(start),
                  "to": iso(session.cursor), "resolution": resolution,
                  "subscriptions": list(dict.fromkeys((resolution, *subscriptions))),
                  "params": {"fast": fast, "slow": slow},
                  "cash": str(cash), "cost": cost.describe(), "rules_mode": "point-in-time",
                  "store": "demo" if demo else "live", "data": result["data_digest"]}
        out = {"run_id": digest(inputs)[:16], "mode": "PAPER", "inputs": inputs, "result": result,
               "baselines": {}, "fx": None, "numeraire": result["quote"],
               "outputs_digest": digest(result)[:16],
               "warnings": ["Live paper session: baselines/USDT attribution require a separate matched replay.",
                            "Assumed example fees; no depth/queue-position model; no capital authorization."]}
        if demo:
            out["warnings"].append("DEMO: never gate evidence.")
        path = save_run(out, root)
        print(f"{session.state}: {path}", flush=True)
    return out

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\src\gym\services\market_statistics.py ===
"""Observed spread distributions, grouped by pair and venue-local hour."""
import hashlib
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from math import ceil
from statistics import median

from ..adapters.store import MarketDB
from ..domain.bars import qualified
from ..domain.model import TEHRAN, iso
from .data_portal import DataPortal


def spread_report(db: MarketDB, start: datetime, end: datetime, *, symbol: str | None = None, store: str = "live") -> dict:
    if start >= end:
        raise ValueError("inverted or empty spread-report range")
    symbols = [symbol] if symbol else [row[0].removeprefix("wallex:") for row in db.c.execute(
        "select distinct instrument_id from book_top where ts_avail>=? and ts_avail<? order by instrument_id",
        (iso(start), iso(end)),
    )]
    samples = defaultdict(list)
    source_hash = hashlib.sha256()
    excluded = 0
    portal = DataPortal(db)
    for pair in symbols:
        for quote in portal.tops(pair, start, end):
            record = [pair, iso(quote.ts_avail), str(quote.bid), str(quote.ask), sorted(quote.flags)]
            source_hash.update((json.dumps(record) + "\n").encode())
            if not qualified(quote):
                excluded += 1
                continue
            hour = quote.ts_avail.astimezone(TEHRAN).hour
            mid = (quote.bid + quote.ask) / 2
            samples[pair, hour].append((quote.ask - quote.bid) / mid * 10000)
    groups = []
    for (pair, hour), values in sorted(samples.items()):
        values.sort()
        statistics = {"min": values[0], "median": median(values),
                      "p95": values[ceil(Decimal("0.95") * len(values)) - 1], "max": values[-1]}
        groups.append({"symbol": pair, "tehran_hour": hour, "samples": len(values),
                       "spread_bps": {name: str(value.quantize(Decimal("0.0001")))
                                      for name, value in statistics.items()}})
    return {
        "from": iso(start), "to_exclusive": iso(end), "store": store, "synthetic": store == "demo",
        "timezone": "Asia/Tehran", "data_digest": source_hash.hexdigest(),
        "samples": sum(group["samples"] for group in groups), "excluded": excluded, "groups": groups,
        "method": "Observation-weighted change-only snapshots plus heartbeats; p95 uses nearest rank. Missing hours have no group.",
        "limitations": ["Not time-weighted. Repeated unchanged snapshots depend on the collector heartbeat.",
                        "Spreads are not realized fees, depth slippage or transport latency.",
                        "Trading windows are not filtered; observed quotes are not proof of executability."]
                        + (["Synthetic DEMO observations are not venue-cost evidence."] if store == "demo" else []),
    }

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\src\gym\services\offline_review_journal.py ===
"""C2 durable offline order-ticket review, no funded approvals or venue writes.

Ticket inputs are fully reconstructed from the allowlisted dry-run calculator.
A recovered ACKNOWLEDGE is never a Tier-1 authorization, and no method can
convert a persisted review into a live order.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from ..domain.assisted_ticket import (
    PREVIEW_FIELDS, TicketUnsafe, _zoned, prepare_preview_from_json,
)

_GENESIS = bytes(32)
_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE ticket_previews (
    preview_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    canonical_json TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE ticket_review_events (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    preview_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES ticket_previews(preview_sha256),
    decision TEXT NOT NULL,
    reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    previous_hash BLOB NOT NULL,
    event_hash BLOB NOT NULL
);
CREATE TRIGGER ticket_previews_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ticket_previews
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'offline preview is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER ticket_previews_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ticket_previews
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'offline preview is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER ticket_review_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ticket_review_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'offline review is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER ticket_review_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ticket_review_events
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'offline review is immutable'); END;
PRAGMA user_version=1;
"""


class ReviewUnsafe(ValueError):
    """Invalid offline review, forged ticket or corrupted persistence."""


def _canonical(ticket: dict) -> dict:
    if type(ticket) is not dict:
        raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket fields must be a JSON object")
    if set(ticket) != (PREVIEW_FIELDS | {
        "estimated_gross_quote", "worst_gross_quote", "worst_fee_quote",
        "worst_total_quote", "break_even_bid", "mode", "source",
        "fee_assumption", "client_id", "funded_authority",
        "order_submitted", "preview_sha256",
    }):
        raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket fields must match the safe offline schema")
    try:
        rerun = prepare_preview_from_json({key: ticket[key] for key in PREVIEW_FIELDS})
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket integrity: unsupported pricing or risk envelope") from None
    if rerun != ticket:
        raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket integrity: modified preview or forged authority")
    return rerun


def _json(value: dict) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _next_hash(previous: bytes, payload: dict) -> bytes:
    raw = _json(payload).encode("ascii")
    return hashlib.sha256(previous + len(raw).to_bytes(8, "big") + raw).digest()


class OfflineReviewJournal:
    """Append-only local queue. All decisions are offline acknowledgments."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path | str):
        path = Path(path)
        if path.is_symlink() or (path.exists() and not path.is_file()):
            raise ReviewUnsafe("review journal must be a regular unsymlinked file")
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=5)
        try:
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000")
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
            version = self.conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
            if version == 0:
                if self.conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN "
                    "('ticket_previews','ticket_review_events')"
                ).fetchone():
                    raise ReviewUnsafe("partial offline review journal schema")
                self.conn.executescript("BEGIN IMMEDIATE;" + _SCHEMA + "COMMIT;")
            elif version != 1:
                raise ReviewUnsafe("unsupported offline review journal schema")
            self._verify()
        except Exception:
            self.conn.close()
            raise

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.conn.close()

    def _verify(self) -> bytes:
        if self.conn.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] != "ok":
            raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: failed SQLite check")
        must = {
            "ticket_previews_no_update", "ticket_previews_no_delete",
            "ticket_review_events_no_update", "ticket_review_events_no_delete",
        }
        actual = {row[0] for row in self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger'"
        )}
        if not must.issubset(actual):
            raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: triggers absent")
        known = {}
        for key, raw in self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT preview_sha256,canonical_json FROM ticket_previews"
        ):
            try:
                record = json.loads(raw)
                canonical = _canonical(record)
                if raw != _json(canonical) or key != canonical["preview_sha256"]:
                    raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: changed preview bytes")
            except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: changed preview") from None
            known[key] = canonical
        previous = _GENESIS
        sequence = 0
        reviewed = set()
        for row in self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT sequence,preview_sha256,decision,reviewed_at,previous_hash,event_hash "
            "FROM ticket_review_events ORDER BY sequence"
        ):
            seq, key, decision, at, prior, claimed = row
            event = {"preview_sha256": key, "decision": decision, "reviewed_at": at}
            if seq != sequence + 1 or key not in known or key in reviewed:
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: missing or duplicated event")
            if decision not in ("ACKNOWLEDGE", "REJECT"):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: unsupported event")
            try:
                moment = _zoned(at)
                ticket = known[key]
                if not _zoned(ticket["observed_at"]) <= moment < _zoned(ticket["expires_at"]):
                    raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: expired decision")
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: invalid decision timestamp") from None
            if prior != previous or claimed != _next_hash(previous, event):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: event hash chain invalid")
            reviewed.add(key)
            sequence, previous = seq, claimed
        return previous

    def record(self, ticket: dict) -> str:
        record = _canonical(ticket)
        key = record["preview_sha256"]
        self.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            self._verify()
            existing = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT canonical_json FROM ticket_previews WHERE preview_sha256=?", (key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if existing and existing[0] != _json(record):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("offline review integrity: conflicting preview hash")
            if not existing:
                self.conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO ticket_previews(preview_sha256,canonical_json) VALUES(?,?)",
                    (key, _json(record)),
                )
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            self.conn.rollback()
            raise
        return key

    def _status(self, key: str) -> str:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT decision FROM ticket_review_events WHERE preview_sha256=?", (key,)
        ).fetchone()
        return "PREVIEWED" if row is None else (
            "ACKNOWLEDGED_OFFLINE" if row[0] == "ACKNOWLEDGE" else "REJECTED_OFFLINE"
        )

    def tickets(self) -> list[dict]:
        self._verify()
        return [
            {"preview_sha256": key, "state": self._status(key),
             "mode": "DRY_RUN", "funded_authority": False,
             "tier1_approval": False, "order_submitted": False}
            for (key,) in self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT preview_sha256 FROM ticket_previews ORDER BY rowid"
            )
        ]

    def review_events(self) -> list[dict]:
        self._verify()
        return [
            {"sequence": seq, "preview_sha256": key,
             "decision": decision, "reviewed_at": at,
             "tier1_approval": False, "funded_authority": False}
            for seq, key, decision, at in self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT sequence,preview_sha256,decision,reviewed_at "
                "FROM ticket_review_events ORDER BY sequence"
            )
        ]

    def review(self, key: str, decision: str, *, at: str) -> dict:
        if decision not in {"ACKNOWLEDGE", "REJECT"}:
            raise ReviewUnsafe("only an offline acknowledgment or rejection is supported")
        try:
            observed = _zoned(at)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            raise ReviewUnsafe("invalid review timestamp") from None
        self.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            previous = self._verify()
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT canonical_json FROM ticket_previews WHERE preview_sha256=?", (key,)
            ).fetchone()
            if not row:
                raise ReviewUnsafe("unknown offline ticket")
            if self._status(key) != "PREVIEWED":
                raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket already reviewed")
            ticket = json.loads(row[0])
            if not _zoned(ticket["observed_at"]) <= observed < _zoned(ticket["expires_at"]):
                raise ReviewUnsafe("ticket expires before review")
            event = {"preview_sha256": key, "decision": decision, "reviewed_at": at}
            digest = _next_hash(previous, event)
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO ticket_review_events(preview_sha256,decision,reviewed_at,"
                "previous_hash,event_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                (key, decision, at, previous, digest),
            )
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            self.conn.rollback()
            raise
        return {
            "preview_sha256": key,
            "state": "ACKNOWLEDGED_OFFLINE" if decision == "ACKNOWLEDGE"
                     else "REJECTED_OFFLINE",
            "mode": "DRY_RUN",
            "tier1_approval": False,
            "funded_authority": False, "order_submitted": False,
        }

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\src\gym\services\paper.py ===
"""Paper replay orchestration, matched baselines and portfolio result aggregation."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

from ..adapters.store import MarketDB
from ..domain.bars import qualified
from ..domain.model import InstrumentId, dec, iso
from ..domain.rules import is_closed
from ..domain.sim import CostModel, Spec
from ..domain.strategy import BuyAndHold, EmaTrend, digest
from .data_portal import DataPortal, rate_at
from .rules import RuleService
from .session import ENGINE_VERSION

CENT = Decimal("1e-8")


def run(portal: DataPortal, rules_for, strategy, symbol: str, t0: datetime, t1: datetime, resolution: str,
        cash: Decimal, cost: CostModel, subscriptions=()) -> dict:
    from .session import PaperSession

    inst = portal.instrument(symbol)
    tops = portal.tops(symbol, t0, t1)
    session = PaperSession(portal, rules_for, strategy, symbol, t0, resolution, cash, cost, subscriptions)
    for top in tops:
        session.feed(top)
    session.finish(t1)
    return session_result(session, tops, cash)


def session_result(session, tops, cash):
    from .session import outcome_marks

    book, last_q, inst = session.book, session.last_quote, session.instrument
    strategy, symbol, cost = session.strategy, session.symbol, session.cost
    decisions, orders, curve = session.decisions, session.orders, session.curve
    outcome_marks(decisions, tops, session.cursor)

    fills = [o for o in orders if o["status"] == "FILLED"]
    # Reported to 1e-8 so the components add up to net exactly; directional is the remainder.
    costs = {k: sum((o["costs"][k] for o in fills), Decimal(0)).quantize(CENT) for k in ("spread", "fees", "latency_drift")}
    end = None
    if last_q:
        eq = book.equity(inst, last_q.bid)
        net = (eq - cash).quantize(CENT)
        end = {"mark_time": iso(last_q.ts_avail), "bid": str(last_q.bid), "equity": str(eq), "net": str(net),
               # Modeled, separately: what selling the holding at that bid would leave after the fee. Not done.
               "net_liquidation_estimate": str(book.get(inst.quote) + book.get(inst.base) * last_q.bid * (1 - cost.fee_rate)),
               "waterfall": {"directional": str(net + sum(costs.values())), **{k: str(-v) for k, v in costs.items()},
                             "net": str(net)}}
        for o in fills:
            o["costs"] = {k: str(v) for k, v in o["costs"].items()}
    nonfills: dict[str, int] = {}
    for o in orders:
        if o["status"] == "NONFILL":
            nonfills[o["reason"]] = nonfills.get(o["reason"], 0) + 1
    return {"strategy": strategy.name, "params": strategy.params, "symbol": symbol, "quote": inst.quote, "base": inst.base,
            "start_cash": str(cash), "observations": len(tops), "qualified": sum(map(qualified, tops)),
            "data_digest": digest([(iso(x.ts_avail), x.bid, x.ask, sorted(x.flags)) for x in tops]),
            "bars": len(decisions), "fills": len(fills), "nonfills": nonfills, "end": end,
            "balances": {k: str(v) for k, v in book.balances.items()}, "curve": curve,
            "decisions": decisions, "orders": orders, "postings": book.postings,
            "session": {"state": session.state, "events": session.events, "cursor": iso(session.cursor),
                        "running_at": session.running_at and iso(session.running_at), "skipped": session.skipped,
                        "subscriptions": list(session.closes.by_resolution), "bar_events": session.bar_events,
                        "reopenings": session.reopenings}}


def paper(db: MarketDB, symbol: str, t0: datetime, t1: datetime, *, resolution: str = "15min", fast: int = 8,
          slow: int = 21, cash: Decimal = Decimal(1000), cost: CostModel = CostModel(), rules_mode: str = "point-in-time",
          store: str = "live", subscriptions=()) -> dict:
    """A replayable paper run plus matched baselines. Same inputs give the same run_id and outputs."""
    if rules_mode not in ("point-in-time", "today"):
        raise ValueError("rules_mode must be 'point-in-time' or 'today'")
    portal, svc = DataPortal(db), RuleService(db)
    today = svc.load()[1]
    rules_for = (lambda t: today) if rules_mode == "today" else (lambda t: svc.load(t)[1])
    inst = portal.instrument(symbol)
    main = run(portal, rules_for, EmaTrend(fast, slow), symbol, t0, t1, resolution, cash, cost, subscriptions)
    if main["qualified"] == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"no qualified {symbol} quotes between {iso(t0)} and {iso(t1)}")
    base_syms = {f"hold {inst.base}": symbol}
    if inst.quote == "TMN":
        base_syms["hold USDT"] = "USDTTMN"
    if inst.base != "BTC":
        base_syms["hold BTC"] = "BTC" + inst.quote
    baselines = {f"hold {inst.quote}": {"end": {"equity": str(cash), "net": "0"}, "fills": 0}}
    for name, s in base_syms.items():
        b = run(portal, rules_for, BuyAndHold(), s, t0, t1, resolution, cash, cost, subscriptions)
        baselines[name] = {k: b[k] for k in ("symbol", "end", "fills", "nonfills")} if b["end"] else {"unavailable": f"no qualified {s} quotes"}

    # Headline numeraire: USDT-equivalent through a disclosed, non-executable valuation rate.
    fx = None
    if inst.quote == "TMN":
        u = portal.tops("USDTTMN", t0 - timedelta(days=1), t1)
        r0, r1 = rate_at(u, t0), rate_at(u, t1)
        if r0 and r1:
            fx = {"pair": "USDTTMN", "start": str(r0[0]), "start_time": iso(r0[1]), "end": str(r1[0]), "end_time": iso(r1[1]),
                  "basis": "MID of last qualified quote; derived valuation rate, not executable"}
            # While USDT/IRT is closed the factor is the last pre-closure mid: usable for valuation, labeled stale.
            usdt = InstrumentId.wallex("USDTTMN")
            for edge, at in (("start", t0), ("end", t1)):
                fx[f"{edge}_status"] = "STALE_CLOSED" if is_closed(rules_for(at), usdt, at) else "LIVE"
    for row in [main, *baselines.values()]:
        e = row.get("end")
        if not e:
            continue
        if inst.quote == "USDT":
            e["net_usdt_eq"] = e["net"]
        elif fx:
            e["net_usdt_eq"] = str((dec(e["equity"]) / dec(fx["end"]) - cash / dec(fx["start"])).quantize(Decimal("0.0001")))
    metadata = portal.metadata_at(symbol, t0)
    metadata_ref = None if metadata is None else {
        "version": metadata["version"], "valid_from": iso(metadata["valid_from"]),
        "valid_to": metadata["valid_to"] and iso(metadata["valid_to"]), "source": metadata["source"],
        "raw_digest": metadata["raw_digest"],
    }
    inputs = {"engine": ENGINE_VERSION, "symbol": symbol, "from": iso(t0), "to": iso(t1), "resolution": resolution,
              "subscriptions": list(dict.fromkeys((resolution, *subscriptions))), "params": main["params"],
              "cash": str(cash), "cost": cost.describe(), "rules_mode": rules_mode, "store": store,
              "data": main["data_digest"], "metadata": metadata_ref, "ruleset_version_now": svc.load()[0]}
    rank = ranking(main, baselines)
    out = {"run_id": digest(inputs)[:16], "mode": "PAPER", "inputs": inputs, "numeraire": "USDT-equivalent" if fx or inst.quote == "USDT" else inst.quote,
           "fx": fx, "result": main, "baselines": baselines, "ranking": rank,
           "warnings": warnings(main, store, rules_mode, portal, symbol, t0)}
    if fx and "STALE_CLOSED" in (fx["start_status"], fx["end_status"]):
        out["warnings"].append("USDT/IRT was closed at a valuation boundary: the FX factor is STALE_CLOSED (last pre-closure mid).")
    if inst.quote == "TMN" and fx is None:
        out["warnings"].append("USDT-equivalent unavailable: no point-in-time FX valuation at the window start/end.")
    out["outputs_digest"] = digest({k: out[k] for k in ("result", "baselines", "ranking", "fx")})[:16]
    return out


def ranking(main, baselines):
    """Matched ranking view; zero-trade results remain visible but are not active strategies."""
    rows = []
    for name, record in {"strategy": main, **baselines}.items():
        end = record.get("end")
        if not end:
            rows.append({"name": name, "status": "UNAVAILABLE", "reason": record.get("unavailable")})
            continue
        fills = record.get("fills", 0)
        rows.append({"name": name, "status": "AVAILABLE", "fills": fills,
                     "classification": "ACTIVE" if fills else "ABSTAINER",
                     "net_quote": end["net"], "quote": main["quote"],
                     "net_usdt_eq": end.get("net_usdt_eq")})
    active = [row.copy() for row in rows
              if row.get("classification") == "ACTIVE" and row.get("net_usdt_eq") is not None]
    active.sort(key=lambda row: (Decimal(row["net_usdt_eq"]), row["name"]), reverse=True)
    for i, row in enumerate(active, 1):
        row["rank"] = i
    return {"headline": "USDT-equivalent", "active": active,
            "abstainers": [row for row in rows if row.get("classification") == "ABSTAINER"], "all": rows,
            "note": "Zero-trade runs are retained as abstainers and excluded from active-trading rank."}


def warnings(main, store, rules_mode, portal, symbol, t0) -> list[str]:
    w = []
    if store == "demo":
        w.append("DEMO data: synthetic quotes. Not evidence; can never reach a gate report.")
    if rules_mode == "today":
        w.append("Re-run under TODAY's rules, not the rules known at each decision.")
    metadata = portal.metadata_at(symbol, t0)
    if metadata is None:
        w.append("Public instrument metadata was unavailable at the window start; fees, flags and capacity remain UNKNOWN.")
    else:
        missing = [name for name in ("isZeroFee", "isMarketTypeEnable") if name not in metadata["raw"]]
        if missing:
            w.append("Historical public metadata leaves " + ", ".join(missing) + " UNKNOWN; current values were not backfilled.")
    if portal.spec_at(symbol, t0) == Spec():
        w.append("Precision and minimums unknown at the start of the window; not enforced.")
    if main["fills"] < 30:
        w.append(f"Only {main['fills']} fills: far too few to claim anything about this strategy.")
    w.append("Fee rate 0.2% is the documentation example and fee currency is an assumption; confirm the account's real fees.")
    return w

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\src\gym\services\probe_budget.py ===
"""C1 offline probe-ladder evidence and immutable loss-budget planner.

No credentials, network transport, order POST, cancellations or certification
exist in this module. Staging a probe is NEVER permission to trade. The
restricted Executor must enforce any real T2 consent and money budget again.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import sqlite3
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from pathlib import Path

from ..domain.account_observations import parse_wallex_balances

_DECIMAL = re.compile(r"(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})(?:\.[0-9]{1,18})?\Z")
_NAME = re.compile(r"[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{0,95}\Z")
_ASSET = re.compile(r"[A-Z0-9]{2,12}\Z")
_SYMBOL = re.compile(r"[A-Z0-9]{5,32}\Z")
_PROBES = {
    "CLIENT_ID_ECHO", "DUPLICATE_ID", "LIMIT_PARTIAL_FILL",
    "CANCEL_RACE", "STOP_LIMIT", "STOP_MARKET", "FEE_ASSET",
    "MARKET_PRICE_GUARD",
}


class ProbeUnsafe(ValueError):
    """Missing, contradictory or over-budget manual probe evidence."""


def _decimal(raw: object, name: str) -> Decimal:
    if type(raw) is not str or not _DECIMAL.fullmatch(raw):
        raise ProbeUnsafe(f"{name} must be a positive exact decimal string")
    value = Decimal(raw)
    if value <= 0:
        raise ProbeUnsafe(f"{name} must be positive")
    return value


def _no_duplicates(pairs):
    value = {}
    for k, v in pairs:
        if k in value:
            raise ValueError("duplicate response key")
        value[k] = v
    return value


def assess_probe_read(*, resource: str, http_status: int,
                      response_bytes: bytes, max_bytes: int = 1_048_576) -> dict:
    """Validate the transport-independent outcome of a *read*.

    This never calls a venue. HTTP 200 alone does NOT prove a status
    mapping, a missing order, a fee schedule or settlement.
    """
    if resource not in {"BALANCES", "FEES", "ORDER_STATUS", "EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE"}:
        raise ProbeUnsafe("unsupported private read resource")
    if type(http_status) is not int or http_status < 100 or http_status > 599:
        raise ProbeUnsafe("invalid HTTP status")
    if type(max_bytes) is not int or not 256 <= max_bytes <= 4_194_304:
        raise ProbeUnsafe("invalid response bound")
    if type(response_bytes) is not bytes:
        raise ProbeUnsafe("response must be bounded bytes")
    result = {
        "resource": resource,
        "state": "UNKNOWN",
        "http_status": http_status,
        "body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(response_bytes).hexdigest()
            if len(response_bytes) <= max_bytes else None,
        "absent_proven": False,
        "method_certified": False,
        "funded_authority": False,
        "authority": "READ_ONLY_UNVERIFIED",
    }
    if http_status != 200 or not 1 <= len(response_bytes) <= max_bytes:
        return result
    try:
        payload = json.loads(
            response_bytes.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=_no_duplicates,
            parse_float=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("floating venue amount")),
            parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("nonfinite venue amount")),
        )
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("success") is not True:
            return result
        if resource == "BALANCES":
            parse_wallex_balances(payload)
        elif resource == "ORDER_STATUS":
            row = payload.get("result")
            if not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(row.get("status"), str) \
                or not 1 <= len(row["status"]) <= 128:
                return result
        else:
            # Shape of fee/exposure contract remains unvalidated; do not
            # promote a nominal 200 into an accepted economic fact.
            return result
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return result
    return {**result, "state": "OBSERVED"}


_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE probe_limits (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
    quote_asset TEXT NOT NULL,
    total_loss_limit TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE probe_stages (
    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    probe_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    symbol TEXT NOT NULL,
    worst_case_total_loss TEXT NOT NULL,
    venue_minimum_quote TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TRIGGER probe_limits_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON probe_limits
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'probe budget is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER probe_limits_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON probe_limits
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'probe budget is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER probe_stages_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON probe_stages
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'probe stages are immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER probe_stages_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON probe_stages
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'probe stages are immutable'); END;
PRAGMA user_version=1;
"""


class ProbeBudgetBook:
    """Durable offline reservations of the operator's total-loss envelope.

    No release path: after a staged probe, its full possible loss continues
    consuming the envelope. A new risk budget requires a separately controlled
    ledger, NOT a quiet reset or a venue-minimum override.
    """
    def __init__(self, path: Path | str, *, total_loss_limit: str, quote_asset: str):
        amount = _decimal(total_loss_limit, "total_loss_limit")
        if type(quote_asset) is not str or not _ASSET.fullmatch(quote_asset):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("invalid quote asset")
        path = Path(path)
        if path.is_symlink() or (path.exists() and not path.is_file()):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("probe ledger must be a regular unsymlinked file")
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=5)
        try:
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000")
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
            self.conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            version = self.conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
            if version == 0:
                if self.conn.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('probe_limits','probe_stages')"
                ).fetchone():
                    raise ProbeUnsafe("partial probe ledger schema")
                self.conn.executescript("BEGIN IMMEDIATE;" + _SCHEMA + "COMMIT;")
                self.conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO probe_limits(id,quote_asset,total_loss_limit) VALUES(1,?,?)",
                    (quote_asset, total_loss_limit),
                )
                self.conn.commit()
            elif version != 1:
                raise ProbeUnsafe("unsupported probe ledger schema")
            self._verify()
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT quote_asset,total_loss_limit FROM probe_limits WHERE id=1"
            ).fetchone()
            if not row or row[0] != quote_asset or _decimal(row[1], "recorded limit") != amount:
                raise ProbeUnsafe("probe total-loss budget is immutable")
            self.cap = amount
            self.quote_asset = quote_asset
        except Exception:
            self.conn.close()
            raise

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.conn.close()

    def _verify(self):
        if self.conn.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] != "ok":
            raise ProbeUnsafe("probe ledger failed SQLite integrity")
        required = {
            "probe_limits_no_update", "probe_limits_no_delete",
            "probe_stages_no_update", "probe_stages_no_delete",
        }
        guards = {name for (name,) in self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger'"
        )}
        if not required.issubset(guards):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("probe ledger immutability guards absent")

    def proposals(self) -> list[dict]:
        self._verify()
        columns = ("probe_id", "kind", "symbol", "worst_case_total_loss", "venue_minimum_quote")
        return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT " + ",".join(columns) + " FROM probe_stages ORDER BY seq"
        )]

    def remaining(self) -> str:
        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 128
            spent = sum((_decimal(r["worst_case_total_loss"], "recorded budget")
                         for r in self.proposals()), Decimal(0))
            left = self.cap - spent
            if left < 0:
                raise ProbeUnsafe("budget ledger exceeds committed operator limit")
            return format(left, "f")

    def stage(self, *, probe_id: str, kind: str, symbol: str,
              worst_case_total_loss: str, venue_minimum_quote: str) -> dict:
        if type(probe_id) is not str or not _NAME.fullmatch(probe_id):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("unsafe probe ID")
        if type(kind) is not str or kind not in _PROBES:
            raise ProbeUnsafe("unknown probe kind")
        if type(symbol) is not str or not _SYMBOL.fullmatch(symbol):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("invalid instrument")
        if not symbol.endswith(self.quote_asset):
            raise ProbeUnsafe("instrument quote asset differs from probe budget unit")
        loss = _decimal(worst_case_total_loss, "worst_case_total_loss")
        minimum = _decimal(venue_minimum_quote, "venue_minimum_quote")
        if minimum > loss:
            raise ProbeUnsafe("venue minimum exceeds accepted per-probe loss")
        self.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            self._verify()
            if self.conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM probe_stages WHERE probe_id=?", (probe_id,)).fetchone():
                raise ProbeUnsafe("duplicate probe ID")
            if loss > Decimal(self.remaining()):
                raise ProbeUnsafe("probe exceeds remaining budget")
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO probe_stages(probe_id,kind,symbol,worst_case_total_loss,venue_minimum_quote) "
                "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
                (probe_id, kind, symbol, worst_case_total_loss, venue_minimum_quote),
            )
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            self.conn.rollback()
            raise
        return {
            "probe_id": probe_id, "kind": kind, "symbol": symbol,
            "max_full_loss_quote": worst_case_total_loss,
            "quote_asset": self.quote_asset, "remaining_after": self.remaining(),
            "state": "OFFLINE_REVIEW_ONLY", "order_submitted": False,
            "client_id": None, "funded_authority": False,
            "requires_independent_t2_consent": True,
        }

"""Human-readable paper results and conservative economic-evidence summaries."""
import json
import math
from decimal import Decimal
from statistics import mean, stdev


def economic_report(out, diag=None):
    result = out["result"]
    inputs = out["inputs"]
    # One observation per completed round trip, not per tick or fill; still serially dependent.
    returns = []
    entry_value = None
    for order in result["orders"]:
        if order["status"] != "FILLED":
            continue
        if order["side"] == "BUY":
            entry_value = Decimal(order["qty"]) * Decimal(order["price"])
        elif entry_value:
            proceeds = Decimal(order["qty"]) * Decimal(order["price"]) - Decimal(order["fee"])
            returns.append(float((proceeds - entry_value) / entry_value))
            entry_value = None

    mean_return = mean(returns) if returns else None
    sample_sigma = stdev(returns) if len(returns) >= 2 else None
    sample_estimate = None
    if mean_return and mean_return > 0 and sample_sigma and sample_sigma > 0:
        sample_estimate = math.ceil((2.8 * sample_sigma / mean_return) ** 2)
    baselines = [(name, Decimal(record["end"]["net"]))
                 for name, record in out["baselines"].items() if record.get("end")]
    strongest = max(baselines, key=lambda baseline: baseline[1]) if baselines else None
    is_demo = inputs["store"] == "demo"
    return {
        "run_id": out["run_id"],
        "outputs_digest": out["outputs_digest"],
        "period": {name: inputs[name] for name in ("from", "to")},
        "currency": result["quote"],
        "completed_round_trips": len(returns),
        "mean_return": mean_return,
        "sample_sigma": sample_sigma,
        "iid_sample_estimate": sample_estimate,
        "strongest_baseline": {"name": strongest[0], "net": str(strongest[1])} if strongest else None,
        "claim_ceiling": "NONE" if is_demo else "EXPERIMENTAL",
        "gate_eligible": False,
        "primary_limitation": (
            "Synthetic DEMO data is never capital evidence." if is_demo else
            "No independent out-of-sample evidence; dependent trades and assumed fees prevent validated claims."
        ),
        "assumptions": inputs["cost"],
        "warnings": out["warnings"],
        "diagnostics": diag,
        "decision": "No capital authorized. Operator decisions are recorded separately; this report cannot arm trading.",
    }


def markdown(report):
    return "# TradingGYM economic evidence\n\n```json\n" + json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n```\n"


def text_report(out: dict) -> str:
    result = out["result"]
    end = result["end"] or {}
    currency = result["quote"]

    def money(value):
        return f"{Decimal(value):>16,.2f}"

    lines = [
        f"PAPER run {out['run_id']}  {result['strategy']} {result['params']} "
        f"on {result['symbol']} {out['inputs']['resolution']}",
        f"window {out['inputs']['from']} .. {out['inputs']['to']}   rules: {out['inputs']['rules_mode']}   "
        f"outputs {out['outputs_digest']}",
        f"bars {result['bars']}  fills {result['fills']}  nonfills {result['nonfills'] or 0}  "
        f"observations {result['observations']} (qualified {result['qualified']})", "",
    ]
    if end:
        lines.append(f"Gross-to-net waterfall ({currency}, mark-to-bid at {end['mark_time']}):")
        for name, value in end["waterfall"].items():
            lines.append(f"  {name:<16}{money(value)}")
        lines.append(f"  {'equity':<16}{money(end['equity'])}   net liquidation estimate (modeled) "
                     f"{money(end['net_liquidation_estimate']).strip()}")
    active = out["ranking"]["active"]
    lines += ["", "active ranking (USDT-equivalent; abstainers excluded):"]
    if active:
        for row in active:
            lines.append(f"  {row['rank']:>2}. {row['name']:<12}{money(row['net_usdt_eq'])} USDT-eq   "
                         f"{money(row['net_quote'])} {row['quote']}")
    else:
        lines.append("  unavailable (no active result with a USDT-equivalent valuation)")
    if out["ranking"]["abstainers"]:
        lines.append("  abstainers: " + ", ".join(row["name"] for row in out["ranking"]["abstainers"]))
    units = ", and USDT-equivalent)" if out["fx"] or currency == "USDT" else ")"
    lines += ["", f"vs baselines (same window, cash, costs; net in {currency}" + units]
    for name, baseline in {"strategy": result, **out["baselines"]}.items():
        if "unavailable" in baseline:
            lines.append(f"  {name:<12} unavailable: {baseline['unavailable']}")
        else:
            baseline_end = baseline["end"]
            line = f"  {name:<12}{money(baseline_end['net'])} {currency}"
            if "net_usdt_eq" in baseline_end:
                line += f"   {money(baseline_end['net_usdt_eq'])} USDT-eq"
            lines.append(line)
    if out["fx"]:
        lines.append(f"  USDT-eq via {out['fx']['pair']} {out['fx']['start']} -> "
                     f"{out['fx']['end']} ({out['fx']['basis']}; start {out['fx'].get('start_status', 'LIVE')}, "
                     f"end {out['fx'].get('end_status', 'LIVE')})")
    lines += ["", *("! " + warning for warning in out["warnings"])]
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""B3 OFFLINE restore inspection only: NO write path, no backup encryption.

Use on a quiescent, independently decrypted staging copy, never on a live
Executor database. The returned hash is evidence, NOT proof of origin unless
it is checked against an authenticated off-machine manifest.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import closing
from urllib.parse import quote


class RestoreUnsafe(ValueError):
    """A candidate cannot be safely considered for a non-destructive restore."""


def inspect_ledger(source: Path | str) -> dict:
    path = Path(source)
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        raise RestoreUnsafe("source is not an independent regular ledger file")
    if Path(str(path) + "-wal").exists() or Path(str(path) + "-shm").exists():
        raise RestoreUnsafe("live SQLite WAL sidecar present; checkpoint a quiescent snapshot")
    previous = bytes(32)
    sequence = 0
    try:
        uri = "file:" + quote(str(path.resolve()), safe="/:") + "?mode=ro&immutable=1"
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True, timeout=1)) as db:
            db.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
            version = db.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
            if version != 1:
                raise RestoreUnsafe("unsupported or missing schema version")
            guards = dict(db.execute(
                "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger' AND "
                "name IN ('ledger_events_no_update', 'ledger_events_no_delete')"))
            if len(guards) != 2 or not all(
                "RAISE(ABORT" in sql.upper() and "BEFORE " + action in sql.upper()
                for action, sql in (("UPDATE", guards.get("ledger_events_no_update", "")),
                                    ("DELETE", guards.get("ledger_events_no_delete", "")))
            ):
                raise RestoreUnsafe("immutable event guards missing or altered")
            if db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] != "ok":
                raise RestoreUnsafe("SQLite structural integrity check failed")
            for idx, raw, stored_prev, stored_hash in db.execute(
                "SELECT sequence,event_bytes,previous_hash,event_hash "
                "FROM ledger_events ORDER BY sequence"
            ):
                expected = sequence + 1
                if type(idx) is not int or idx != expected:
                    raise RestoreUnsafe("ledger sequence missing or out of order")
                if not isinstance(raw, bytes) or not 1 <= len(raw) <= 1_048_576:
                    raise RestoreUnsafe("invalid stored event bytes")
                if not isinstance(stored_prev, bytes) or len(stored_prev) != 32 or stored_prev != previous:
                    raise RestoreUnsafe("ledger previous hash mismatch")
                current = hashlib.sha256(
                    previous + len(raw).to_bytes(8, "big") + raw
                ).digest()
                if not isinstance(stored_hash, bytes) or stored_hash != current:
                    raise RestoreUnsafe("ledger event hash mismatch")
                previous = current
                sequence = idx
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("unreadable or damaged SQLite candidate") from None
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as data:
        while block := data.read(1_048_576):
            digest.update(block)
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "sequence": sequence,
        "head_hash": previous.hex(),
        "file_sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
        "encrypted": False,
        "trusted_origin": False,
    }


def check_restore_target(source: Path | str, destination: Path | str) -> dict:
    """Admission check ONLY. Never creates/replaces the destination."""
    src, dst = Path(source), Path(destination)
    if dst.exists() or dst.is_symlink():
        raise RestoreUnsafe("destination already exists; no overwrite is allowed")
    if src.parent.resolve() == dst.parent.resolve() and src.name == dst.name:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("source cannot be restored over itself")
    if (src.parent / "secrets.dat").exists():
        raise RestoreUnsafe("secrets.dat must never be present in a backup bundle")
    # The chosen destination and account credentials are NOT touched here.
    # Encryption/authenticated manifest and off-machine restore remain gates.
    return inspect_ledger(src)


def assess_migration_staging(state: dict) -> dict:
    """Pure B3 STAGING refusal policy; never invokes an updater.

    All asserted facts must be verified by a privileged release controller
    and linked to fresh evidence. A caller-supplied dictionary is NOT proof
    of these claims and cannot authorize installation, keys or funded arming.
    """
    if not isinstance(state, dict):
        raise RestoreUnsafe("missing update preflight facts")
    for name in ("active_funded_authority", "ledger_integrity_verified",
                 "off_machine_restore_proven", "migration_rehearsed"):
        if type(state.get(name)) is not bool:
            raise RestoreUnsafe("missing or malformed update preflight evidence")
    for name in ("unresolved_orders", "current_schema", "target_schema"):
        if type(state.get(name)) is not int:
            raise RestoreUnsafe("missing or malformed schema/order fact")
    if state["unresolved_orders"] < 0 or state["current_schema"] < 1:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("invalid outstanding order/schema state")
    if state["active_funded_authority"] or state["unresolved_orders"] > 0:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("unsafe update while trading authority or orders remain")
    if not all(state[key] for key in (
        "ledger_integrity_verified", "off_machine_restore_proven", "migration_rehearsed"
    )):
        raise RestoreUnsafe("staged update lacks verified migration or recovery evidence")
    if state["target_schema"] != state["current_schema"] + 1:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("only single forward schema migration is permitted")
    return {
        "allow_staged_update": True,
        "install_authorized": False,
        "funded_arming": False,
    }


def _expected_digest(value: str) -> str:
    """Compare trusted out-of-band digests; do NOT authenticate them here."""
    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 64 or any(
        c not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c in value
    ):
        raise RestoreUnsafe("expected digest must be 64 hexadecimal characters")
    return value.lower()


def inspect_pinned_ledger(
    source: Path | str, *,
    expected_head_hash: str, expected_file_sha256: str,
) -> dict:
    """Reject any mismatch against independently authenticated external data.

    This does not authenticate the manifest, decrypt a backup, or install it.
    Calling code must separately establish the trusted provenance of the
    expected digests and ensure the staging copy cannot change during checks.
    """
    expected_head_hash = _expected_digest(expected_head_hash)
    expected_file_sha256 = _expected_digest(expected_file_sha256)
    report = inspect_ledger(source)
    if report["head_hash"] != expected_head_hash:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("expected ledger head hash does not match")
    if report["file_sha256"] != expected_file_sha256:
        raise RestoreUnsafe("expected backup file sha256 does not match")
    # Not an authenticated source: matching a caller-supplied digest is NOT
    # equivalent to verifying a trusted, signed or AEAD-protected manifest.
    return report


def check_pinned_restore_target(
    source: Path | str, destination: Path | str, *,
    expected_head_hash: str, expected_file_sha256: str,
) -> dict:
    """Evaluate only; never create, overwrite or rename an active ledger."""
    check_restore_target(source, destination)
    return inspect_pinned_ledger(
        source, expected_head_hash=expected_head_hash,
        expected_file_sha256=expected_file_sha256,
    )

"""Rule service: the only writer of the regulation ledger. Shared by API and gymctl."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from ..adapters.store import MarketDB
from ..domain.model import InstrumentId, iso
from ..domain.rules import PRESETS, effective_status, evaluate, next_change, parse_rule

CHECKS = (("entry", "BUY", "ENTRY"), ("exit", "SELL", "EXIT"))


class RuleService:
    def __init__(self, db: MarketDB):
        self.db = db

    def load(self, at: datetime | None = None):
        version, docs = self.db.rules_as_of(at)
        rules, quarantined = [], []
        for d in docs.values():
            try:
                rules.append(parse_rule(d))
            except ValueError as e:
                quarantined.append({"id": d.get("id"), "error": str(e), "body": d})
        return version, rules, quarantined

    def put(self, d: dict, now: datetime, op: str = "edit", actor: str = "operator") -> int:
        parse_rule(d)  # reject invalid edits outright; only imports may land in quarantine
        exists = d["id"] in self.db.rules_as_of()[1]
        return self.db.put_rule(d, op if exists or op != "edit" else "add", actor, now)

    def _current(self, rule_id: str) -> dict:
        docs = self.db.rules_as_of()[1]
        if rule_id not in docs:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown rule {rule_id!r}")
        return docs[rule_id]

    def disable(self, rule_id: str, now: datetime, actor: str = "operator") -> int:
        return self.db.put_rule({**self._current(rule_id), "disabled": True}, "disable", actor, now)

    def rollback(self, rule_id: str, seq: int, now: datetime, actor: str = "operator") -> int:
        self._current(rule_id)
        old = next((e for e in self.db.rule_events(rule_id) if e["seq"] == seq), None)
        if old is None:
            raise ValueError(f"rule {rule_id!r} has no event #{seq}")
        return self.db.put_rule(old["body"], "rollback", actor, now)

    def import_(self, docs: list, now: datetime, op: str = "import", actor: str = "operator") -> dict:
        if not isinstance(docs, list) or not all(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("id") for d in docs):
            raise ValueError("import expects a JSON list of rule objects, each with an id")
        bad = []
        for d in docs:
            try:
                parse_rule(d)
            except ValueError as e:
                bad.append({"id": d["id"], "error": str(e)})
            self.db.put_rule(d, op, actor, now)
        return {"imported": len(docs), "quarantined": bad}

    def preset(self, name: str, now: datetime, actor: str = "operator") -> dict:
        if name not in PRESETS:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown preset {name!r}; have {sorted(PRESETS)}")
        return self.import_(PRESETS[name], now, "preset:" + name, actor)

    def export(self) -> list[dict]:
        return list(self.db.rules_as_of()[1].values())

    def check(self, inst: InstrumentId, side: str, intent: str, now: datetime, *, at_rules: datetime | None = None,
              used: Decimal = Decimal(0)) -> dict:
        version, rules, _ = self.load(at_rules)
        v = evaluate(rules, inst, side, intent, now, used=used, version=version)
        return {"allowed": v.allowed, "blockers": list(v.blockers), "warnings": list(v.warnings),
                "quota_remaining": None if v.quota_remaining is None else str(v.quota_remaining),
                "ruleset_version": version, "at": iso(now),
                "next_change": iso(next_change(rules, inst, side, intent, now, used=used, version=version))}

    def act(self, inst: InstrumentId, now: datetime) -> dict:
        """Pair-scoped 'When can I act?': entry (buy) and exit (sell) right now, and when that flips."""
        return {name: self.check(inst, side, intent, now) for name, side, intent in CHECKS}

    def listing(self, now: datetime, insts: list[InstrumentId]) -> dict:
        version, rules, quarantined = self.load()
        out = {"version": version, "rules": [], "quarantined": quarantined}
        for r in rules:
            if r.disabled:
                state = "disabled"
            elif now < r.effective_from:
                state = "scheduled"
            elif r.effective_until and now >= r.effective_until:
                state = "expired"
            else:
                state = "stale" if effective_status(r, now) == "STALE" else "active"
            blocks = sorted({f"{i.symbol} {n}" for i in insts for n, side, intent in CHECKS
                             if evaluate([r], i, side, intent, now).blockers})
            out["rules"].append({"state": state, "blocks_now": blocks, "body": self._current(r.id),
                                 "history": [{k: e[k] for k in ("seq", "ts", "op", "actor")} for e in self.db.rule_events(r.id)]})
        return out
