=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_encrypted_backup.py ===
"""B3 portable passphrase-encrypted backups and non-destructive restore."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sqlite3

import pytest

from gym.services.encrypted_backup import (
    BackupAuthenticationError,
    BackupUnsafe,
    create_backup,
    restore_backup,
)


def _symlink_or_skip(link, target):
    try:
        link.symlink_to(target)
    except OSError as exc:  # Windows without SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege
        pytest.skip(f"symlinks unavailable: {exc}")


def make_ledger(path: Path, events=(b"one", b"two")):
    schema = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "executor/exec-store/schema.sql").read_text()
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.executescript(schema)
    previous = bytes(32)
    for sequence, raw in enumerate(events, 1):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(previous + len(raw).to_bytes(8, "big") + raw).digest()
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ledger_events(sequence,event_bytes,previous_hash,event_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
            (sequence, raw, previous, digest),
        )
        previous = digest
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return previous.hex()


def test_backup_is_portable_authenticated_and_restores_to_new_machine_path(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    destination = tmp_path / "second-machine" / "exec_ledger.db"
    expected_head = make_ledger(source)
    (tmp_path / "secrets.dat").write_bytes(b"VENUE SECRET MUST NEVER BE BACKED UP")
    manifest = create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    assert manifest["encrypted"] is True
    assert manifest["schema_version"] == 1
    assert manifest["head_hash"] == expected_head
    assert manifest["trusted_origin"] is False
    assert manifest["authentication"] == "AES-256-GCM passphrase AEAD"
    assert b"VENUE SECRET MUST NEVER BE BACKED UP" not in bundle.read_bytes()
    restored = restore_backup(bundle, destination, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    assert restored["head_hash"] == expected_head
    assert restored["sequence"] == 2
    assert restored["authenticated"] is True
    # SQLite online backup makes a new, logically identical snapshot. The
    # on-disk WAL header/counters can differ from the original live database.
    with sqlite3.connect(source) as original_db, sqlite3.connect(destination) as recovered_db:
        sql = "SELECT sequence, event_bytes, previous_hash, event_hash FROM ledger_events ORDER BY sequence"
        assert original_db.execute(sql).fetchall() == recovered_db.execute(sql).fetchall()
    from gym.services.restore_gate import inspect_ledger
    assert inspect_ledger(destination)["head_hash"] == expected_head


def test_wrong_passphrase_and_ciphertext_tampering_never_publish_restore(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    expected = make_ledger(source)
    create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    wrong_dest = tmp_path / "wrong.db"
    with pytest.raises(BackupAuthenticationError):
        restore_backup(bundle, wrong_dest, passphrase="incorrect passphrase")
    assert not wrong_dest.exists()
    raw = bytearray(bundle.read_bytes())
    raw[-20] ^= 0x40
    bundle.write_bytes(raw)
    tampered_dest = tmp_path / "tampered.db"
    with pytest.raises(BackupAuthenticationError):
        restore_backup(bundle, tampered_dest, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    assert not tampered_dest.exists()


def test_restore_refuses_existing_destination_without_modifying_it(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    make_ledger(source)
    create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    destination = tmp_path / "active.db"
    destination.write_bytes(b"active ledger must not be overwritten")
    with pytest.raises(BackupUnsafe, match="exists"):
        restore_backup(bundle, destination, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    assert destination.read_bytes() == b"active ledger must not be overwritten"


def test_backup_refuses_symlink_source_existing_bundle_and_weak_passphrase(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    make_ledger(source)
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    with pytest.raises(BackupUnsafe, match="passphrase"):
        create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="short")
    create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    with pytest.raises(BackupUnsafe, match="exists"):
        create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    link = tmp_path / "linked.db"
    _symlink_or_skip(link, source)
    with pytest.raises(BackupUnsafe):
        create_backup(link, tmp_path / "link.tgbak", passphrase="correct horse battery staple")


def test_backup_bundle_truncation_and_unknown_version_fail_closed(tmp_path):
    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    make_ledger(source)
    create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    raw = bundle.read_bytes()
    truncated = tmp_path / "truncated.tgbak"
    truncated.write_bytes(raw[:32])
    with pytest.raises(BackupAuthenticationError):
        restore_backup(truncated, tmp_path / "truncated.db", passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    unknown = bytearray(raw)
    unknown[0] ^= 1
    bad = tmp_path / "bad.tgbak"
    bad.write_bytes(unknown)
    with pytest.raises(BackupAuthenticationError):
        restore_backup(bad, tmp_path / "bad.db", passphrase="correct horse battery staple")


def test_backup_failure_before_open_never_unlinks_someone_elses_bundle(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import gym.services.encrypted_backup as backup_mod

    source = tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    bundle = tmp_path / "portable.tgbak"
    make_ledger(source)
    sentinel = b"OTHER PROCESS CREATED THIS BUNDLE"

    def failure_during_snapshot(_source, _snapshot):
        # Reproduce a filesystem race after the early exists() check.
        bundle.write_bytes(sentinel)
        raise BackupUnsafe("simulated snapshot failure")

    monkeypatch.setattr(backup_mod, "_snapshot_database", failure_during_snapshot)
    with pytest.raises(BackupUnsafe, match="simulated"):
        create_backup(source, bundle, passphrase="correct horse battery staple")
    assert bundle.read_bytes() == sentinel


def test_ci_checks_lock_without_granting_token_write_permissions():
    ci = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / ".github/workflows/validate.yml").read_text()
    assert "update-python-lock:" not in ci
    assert "contents: write" not in ci
    assert "uv lock --check" in ci
    assert "uv sync --locked --group dev" in ci

import json

from gym.domain.model import iso

def test_marks_do_not_mature_early():
    decisions = [{"t": iso(START)}]
    rows = [quote(START + timedelta(minutes=16), "100", "101"), quote(START + timedelta(minutes=65), "105", "106")]
    outcome_marks(decisions, rows, START + timedelta(minutes=70))
    m = decisions[0]["marks"]
    assert m["15"]["status"] == "MATURE"
    assert m["60"]["status"] == "OBSERVED_AFTER_GAP" and m["60"]["delay_s"] == 300
    assert m["240"]["status"] == "PENDING"
    outcome_marks(decisions, [], START + timedelta(hours=5))
    assert decisions[0]["marks"]["240"]["status"] == "MISSING"


def test_diagnostics_report_and_demo_capital_guard(tmp_path):
    db = market_db(tmp_path, quote_history(n=2000))
    t0, t1 = START + timedelta(hours=1), START + timedelta(hours=4)
    out = paper(db, "BTCUSDT", t0, t1, resolution="1min", fast=2, slow=3, store="demo")
    diag = diagnostics(db, out)
    assert all(v["status"] == "PASS" for v in diag["checks"].values())
    assert [r["cost_multiplier"] for r in diag["cost_stress"]] == ["0", "1", "1.25", "2", "3"]
    assert diag["cost_stress"][1]["net"] == out["result"]["end"]["net"]
    assert set(diag["cost_stress"][2]["components"]) == {"spread", "fees", "latency_drift"}
    assert diag["warmup-stability"]["status"] == "PASS"
    assert diag["warmup-stability"]["prehistory_observations"] > 0
    report = economic_report(out, diag)
    assert report["claim_ceiling"] == "NONE" and not report["gate_eligible"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        record_decision(tmp_path, out, "EXPERIMENTAL", "1", "USDT", "test", START)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        record_decision(tmp_path, out, "VALIDATED", "0", "USDT", "test", START)
    p = record_decision(tmp_path, out, "NONE", "0", "USDT", "insufficient evidence", START)
    assert json.loads(p.read_text())["permission"] == "RECORD_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY"
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        record_decision(tmp_path, out, "NONE", "0", "USDT", "insufficient evidence", START)
    assert first_divergence([{"t":"t", "action":"HOLD"}], [{"action":"BUY_REQUEST"}])["field"] == "action"
    for rid in ("../secret", "A" * 16, "f" * 17):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            run_path(tmp_path, rid)

import hashlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURE = ROOT / "contracts/v1/fixtures/genesis-event.json"
SCHEMA = ROOT / "executor/exec-store/schema.sql"
GOLDEN_HASH = "d180d43ebb90c9d8f4d9d1ea683f9baa019a328f619b94ef0011968ea6dcd6db"


def test_stored_bytes_have_documented_hash():
    event = FIXTURE.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(bytes(32) + len(event).to_bytes(8, "big") + event).hexdigest()
    assert digest == GOLDEN_HASH
    assert hashlib.sha256(bytes(32) + (len(event) + 1).to_bytes(8, "big") + event).hexdigest() != digest


def test_sql_schema_is_append_only_with_forward_version():
    db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    db.executescript(SCHEMA.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert db.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0] == 1
    payload = FIXTURE.read_bytes()
    digest = hashlib.sha256(bytes(32) + len(payload).to_bytes(8, "big") + payload).digest()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO ledger_events VALUES (?,?,?,?)", (1, payload, bytes(32), digest))
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        db.execute("UPDATE ledger_events SET event_bytes=? WHERE sequence=1", (b"altered",))
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        db.execute("DELETE FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence=1")
    assert db.execute("SELECT event_bytes FROM ledger_events").fetchone()[0] == payload

"""Release guard for the *runtime* token proof (not a Windows acceptance test).

Only an actual Windows process-token query can prove the restricted service SID.
The static checks ensure the source cannot silently revert to account-name-only
checks; behavior is independently expressed in Rust policy tests.
"""
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HOST = ROOT / "executor/exec-svc/src/main.rs"
IDENTITY = ROOT / "executor/exec-svc/src/windows_identity.rs"
POLICY = ROOT / "executor/exec-svc/src/lib.rs"
RUST_TEST = ROOT / "executor/exec-svc/tests/restricted_service_identity.rs"


def test_windows_host_requires_restricted_service_token_not_just_account():
    body = HOST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "is_restricted_executor_service" in body
    assert "if !exec_svc::windows_identity::is_local_service()" not in body
    assert "ServiceState::Stopped, 5" in body


def test_service_identity_comes_from_os_token_groups_and_restrictions():
    body = IDENTITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for key in ("OpenProcessToken", "TokenUser", "TokenGroups", "TokenRestrictedSids",
                "LookupAccountNameW", "GetTokenInformation"):
        assert key in body
    assert r'NT SERVICE\\TradingGYMExecutor' in body
    assert "std::env::var" not in body


def test_policy_requires_both_enabled_group_and_restricting_sid():
    policy = POLICY.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    tests = RUST_TEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "is_restricted_executor_token" in policy
    assert "TokenGroup" in policy
    assert "enabled" in policy
    assert "restricting_sids" in policy
    assert "rejects_missing_disabled_or_wrong_service_group" in tests
    assert "rejects_missing_or_different_restricted_sid" in tests

"""B1 offline manual order provenance is visible but never money-authoritative."""
import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path

from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer

from gym.adapters.store import MarketDB, SegmentWriter
from gym.api.server import make_app
from gym.cli import main
from gym.services.collector import Collector
from gym.services.external_journal import ExternalJournal
from gym.services.rules import RuleService


def test_manual_json_observation_cli_is_durable_and_api_is_token_protected(tmp_path):
    external = {
        "account_id": "main", "observed_at": "2026-10-31T15:01:00Z",
        "orders": [{"client_id": "external-1", "status": "new-unverified", "filled": "0.25",
                    "symbol": "BTCUSDT", "api_key": "DO-NOT-STORE"}],
    }
    source = tmp_path / "manual.json"
    source.write_text(json.dumps(external), "utf-8")
    assert main(["--data", str(tmp_path), "external-observe", str(source)]) == 0

    path = tmp_path / "live" / "external_journal.db"
    with ExternalJournal(path) as journal:
        rows = journal.events()
        assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["raw_status"] == "new-unverified"
        assert "DO-NOT-STORE" not in str(rows)

        db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "market.db")
        col = Collector(db, SegmentWriter(tmp_path / "raw", db), ["BTCUSDT"])
        async def check():
            app = make_app(col, RuleService(db), "tok", external_journal=journal)
            async with TestClient(TestServer(app, host="127.0.0.1")) as c:
                assert (await c.get("/api/external-order-events")).status == 403
                r = await c.get("/api/external-order-events", headers={"X-Gym-Token": "tok"})
                assert r.status == 200
                data = await r.json()
                assert data["authority"] == "READ_ONLY"
                assert data["events"][0]["settlement"] == "UNKNOWN"
                assert "DO-NOT-STORE" not in await r.text()
        asyncio.run(check())
        db.c.close()


def test_external_order_ui_has_bilingual_journal_and_no_settlement_claims():
    ui = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "gym" / "ui"
    html = (ui / "index.html").read_text("utf-8")
    js = (ui / "app.js").read_text("utf-8")
    assert 'id="external-order-events"' in html
    assert 'data-t="externalHistory"' in html
    assert "/api/external-order-events" in js
    assert "async function externalJournal()" in js
    assert "مشاهدات" in js and "unverified" in js.lower()

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_external_journal.py ===
"""B1 external Journal: durable, monotone, never authoritative money fills."""
import sqlite3
import pytest

from gym.domain.account_observations import project_account
from gym.services.external_journal import ExternalJournal


def observation(at, status="open", filled="0"):
    orders = [] if status is None else [{"client_id": "manual-1", "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
                                         "status": status, "filled": filled}]
    return project_account("main", at, orders=orders)


def test_manual_observation_is_append_only_and_survives_restart(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "external_journal.db"
    first = observation("2026-10-31T15:00:00Z")
    with ExternalJournal(path) as j:
        assert j.record(first) == 1
        assert j.record(first) == 0
        assert len(j.events()) == 1
    with ExternalJournal(path) as j:
        assert len(j.events()) == 1
        assert j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:01:00Z", "canceled", "0.25")) == 1
        rows = j.events()
        assert rows[-1]["raw_status"] == "canceled"
        assert rows[-1]["filled_observed"] == "0.25"
        assert rows[-1]["settlement"] == "UNKNOWN"
        assert rows[-1]["economic_effect"] == "UNVERIFIED"
        assert rows[-1]["authority"] == "READ_ONLY"


def test_missing_venue_list_row_cannot_erase_an_external_order(tmp_path):
    with ExternalJournal(tmp_path / "external.db") as j:
        j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:00:00Z", "open"))
        assert j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:01:00Z", None)) == 0
        assert len(j.events()) == 1


def test_stale_snapshot_or_decreasing_cumulative_fill_fails_closed(tmp_path):
    with ExternalJournal(tmp_path / "external.db") as j:
        j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:02:00Z", "partial", "0.25"))
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stale"):
            j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:01:00Z", "open", "0"))
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="regressed"):
            j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:03:00Z", "canceled", "0.20"))
        assert len(j.events()) == 1


def test_different_accounts_are_separate_and_forged_authority_is_rejected(tmp_path):
    main = observation("2026-10-31T15:00:00Z")
    credit = project_account("subaccount:credit-1", "2026-10-31T15:00:00Z",
              orders=[{"client_id": "manual-1", "status": "open", "filled": "0"}])
    with ExternalJournal(tmp_path / "external.db") as j:
        assert j.record(main) == 1
        assert j.record(credit) == 1
        forged = dict(main, authority="FUNDED")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="read-only"):
            j.record(forged)
        assert len(j.events()) == 2
        assert {r["account_id"] for r in j.events()} == {"main", "subaccount:credit-1"}


def test_sqlite_event_rows_are_immutable(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "external.db"
    with ExternalJournal(path) as j:
        j.record(observation("2026-10-31T15:00:00Z"))
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
        db.execute("UPDATE external_order_events SET raw_status='fake'")
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
        db.execute("DELETE FROM external_order_events")
    db.close()

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_feed_crosscheck.py ===
"""Venue candles against internal LAST bars built from collected trades."""
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from gym.adapters.wallex import parse_udf
from gym.domain.bars import BarSpec, trade_bars
from gym.domain.model import TradeTick
from gym.services.data_portal import DataPortal
from gym.services.feed_crosscheck import candle_crosscheck
from tests.support import START, market_db, quote

# Shape captured from GET https://api.wallex.ir/v1/udf/history?symbol=BTCUSDT&resolution=1 on 2026-10-31.
UDF = ('{"s":"ok","t":[%d,%d],"o":["100","200"],"h":["110","210"],"l":["90","190"],"c":["105","205"],'
       '"v":["0.00593456","0"]}' % (START.timestamp(), START.timestamp() + 60))


def trade(seconds, price, qty="0.1"):
    at = START + timedelta(seconds=seconds)
    return TradeTick("BTCUSDT", at, at + timedelta(seconds=1), Decimal(price), Decimal(qty), "BUY")


def test_udf_history_parses_exact_decimals_and_rejects_malformed_columns():
    candles = parse_udf(UDF)
    assert candles[0]["t"] == START and candles[0]["v"] == Decimal("0.00593456") and candles[1]["c"] == Decimal("205")
    assert parse_udf('{"s":"no_data"}') == []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="length"):
        parse_udf('{"s":"ok","t":[1],"o":[],"h":[],"l":[],"c":[],"v":[]}')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="status"):
        parse_udf('{"s":"error"}')


def test_trade_bars_bucket_by_event_time_and_emit_closed_bars_only():
    trades = [trade(30, "105"), trade(0, "100"), trade(61, "200")]
    bars = trade_bars("BTCUSDT", BarSpec("1min", "LAST"), trades, START + timedelta(seconds=90))
    assert len(bars) == 1  # the second minute is still open at 09:01:30
    assert len(trade_bars("BTCUSDT", BarSpec("1min", "LAST"), trades, START + timedelta(minutes=2))) == 2
    b = bars[0]
    assert (b.start, b.open, b.close, b.volume, b.count) == (START, Decimal(100), Decimal(105), Decimal("0.2"), 2)


def crosscheck_db(tmp_path, trades, candles, fetched_late=True, listening=True):
    db = market_db(tmp_path, [quote(START + timedelta(seconds=s), "100", "101") for s in range(0, 600, 60)] if listening else [])
    for t in trades:
        db.add_trade(t, "ws:test")
    fetched = START + timedelta(minutes=10 if fetched_late else 0, seconds=30)
    db.upsert_candles("BTCUSDT", "1min", candles, fetched)
    return DataPortal(db)


def candle(minute, o, h, l, c, v="1"):
    return {"t": START + timedelta(minutes=minute), **{k: Decimal(x) for k, x in zip("ohlcv", (o, h, l, c, v))}}


def test_agreeing_divergent_and_missing_periods_are_classified(tmp_path):
    trades = [trade(0, "100"), trade(30, "110"), trade(40, "90"), trade(50, "105"),  # minute 0 matches the venue
              trade(60, "300"), trade(90, "300"),  # minute 1 differs wildly
              trade(240, "100"), trade(300, "100")]  # minute 4 the venue lacks; minute 5 still open
    candles = [candle(0, "100", "110", "90", "105"), candle(1, "200", "210", "190", "205"),
               candle(2, "100", "100", "100", "100"),  # venue traded while we listened and saw nothing
               candle(3, "100", "100", "100", "100", "0")]  # zero volume: carried price, not compared
    report = candle_crosscheck(crosscheck_db(tmp_path, trades, candles), "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(minutes=10))
    status = {row["t"][11:16]: row["status"] for row in report["periods"]}
    assert status == {"09:00": "AGREE", "09:01": "DIVERGENT", "09:02": "MISSING_INTERNAL", "09:04": "MISSING_VENUE",
                      "09:05": "MISSING_VENUE"}
    assert report["counts"]["AGREE"] == 1 and report["periods"][1]["worst_bps"] == "5789.47"  # low: |300 - 190| / 190


def test_venue_candles_still_forming_when_fetched_are_not_compared(tmp_path):
    portal = crosscheck_db(tmp_path, [trade(0, "100")], [candle(0, "999", "999", "999", "999")], fetched_late=False)
    assert candle_crosscheck(portal, "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(minutes=2))["counts"] == {"MISSING_VENUE": 1}


def test_venue_trading_while_the_collector_was_off_is_not_a_divergence(tmp_path):
    portal = crosscheck_db(tmp_path, [], [candle(0, "100", "100", "100", "100")], listening=False)
    assert candle_crosscheck(portal, "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(minutes=2))["counts"] == {"NOT_COVERED": 1}

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_historical_metadata.py ===
"""Historical public Wallex metadata remains point-in-time and lossless (DATA-02)."""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import timedelta

from gym.adapters.store import MarketDB
from gym.domain.model import iso
from gym.services import collector as collector_module
from gym.services.collector import Collector
from gym.services.data_portal import DataPortal

from .support import START


class _Segments:
    def write(self, *_args):
        return "segment"


def test_historical_public_metadata(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    first = {
        "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
        "baseAsset": "BTC",
        "quoteAsset": "USDT",
        "enName": "Bitcoin",
        "faName": "بیت کوین",
        "stepSize": "6",
        "publicExtra": {"tier": "legacy"},
    }
    second = {
        "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
        "baseAsset": "BTC",
        "quoteAsset": "USDT",
        "enName": "Bitcoin",
        "faName": "بیت کوین",
        "stepSize": "5",
        "minNotional": "10",
    }
    snapshots = iter((first, second))

    async def get_text(_session, path):
        assert path == "/hector/web/v1/markets"
        return json.dumps({"result": {"markets": [next(snapshots)]}})

    later = START + timedelta(days=1)
    times = iter((START, later))
    monkeypatch.setattr(collector_module.wallex, "get_text", get_text)
    monkeypatch.setattr(collector_module, "now_utc", lambda: next(times))

    db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "market.db")
    collector = Collector(db, _Segments(), ["BTCUSDT"])
    asyncio.run(collector.load_catalog(None))
    portal = DataPortal(db)

    assert portal.metadata_at("BTCUSDT", START - timedelta(microseconds=1)) is None
    original = portal.metadata_at("BTCUSDT", START)
    assert original["raw"] == first
    assert "minNotional" not in original["raw"]

    asyncio.run(collector.load_catalog(None))
    assert portal.metadata_at("BTCUSDT", START) == {
        **original,
        "valid_to": later,
    }
    current = portal.metadata_at("BTCUSDT", later)
    assert current["raw"] == second
    assert "publicExtra" not in current["raw"]

    stored = db.c.execute(
        "select rowid, valid_from, valid_to, spec, source from instrument_specs where rowid=?",
        (original["version"],),
    ).fetchone()
    assert original["valid_from"] == START and stored[2] == iso(later)
    assert original["source"] == stored[4] == "rest:/hector/web/v1/markets"
    assert original["version"] == stored[0]
    assert original["raw_digest"] == hashlib.sha256(stored[3].encode()).hexdigest()


def test_custom_symbol_overlays_follow_catalog(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    rows = [
        {"symbol": "BTCUSDT", "base_asset": "BTC", "quote_asset": "USDT"},
        {"symbol": "ETHUSDT", "base_asset": "ETH", "quote_asset": "USDT", "flags": ["isRisky"]},
    ]

    async def rest_text(_session, _path, **_params):
        return json.dumps({"result": {"markets": rows}})

    db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "custom.db")
    collector = Collector(db, _Segments(), ["BTCUSDT"],
                          add_symbols=("ethusdt", "missingusdt"), remove_symbols=("btcusdt", "ghostusdt"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(collector, "rest_text", rest_text)
    asyncio.run(collector.load_catalog(None))

    assert list(collector.insts) == ["ETHUSDT"]
    assert collector.universe["observed_assets"] == ["ETH"]
    assert collector.universe["added_markets"] == ["ETHUSDT"]
    assert collector.universe["removed_markets"] == ["BTCUSDT"]
    assert collector.universe["remove_requests"] == ["BTCUSDT", "GHOSTUSDT"]
    assert collector.universe["custom_note"] == "custom additions are observed only and bypass ranking filters"
    assert set(db.c.execute("select instrument_id from quality_events where flag='SOURCE_ERROR'").fetchall()) == {
        ("wallex:MISSINGUSDT",), ("wallex:GHOSTUSDT",),
    }


def test_ranked_universe_is_balanced_and_shard_safe():
    markets = [{
        "symbol": "USDTTMN", "base_asset": "USDT", "quote_asset": "TMN", "is_spot": True,
        "price": "250000", "quote_volume_24h": "1000000000", "flags": [],
    }]
    for n in range(60):
        for quote in ("TMN", "USDT"):
            markets.append({
                "symbol": f"A{n}{quote}", "base_asset": f"A{n}", "quote_asset": quote, "is_spot": True,
                "quote_volume_24h": str((60 - n) * (250000 if quote == "TMN" else 1)), "flags": [],
            })
    markets += [
        {"symbol": "RISKUSDT", "base_asset": "RISK", "quote_asset": "USDT", "is_spot": True,
         "quote_volume_24h": "999999999", "flags": ["isRisky"]},
        {"symbol": "OFFUSDT", "base_asset": "OFF", "quote_asset": "USDT", "is_spot": False,
         "quote_volume_24h": "999999999", "flags": []},
    ]

    symbols, info = collector_module.select_universe(markets, 50)

    assert len(info["selected_assets"]) == 50
    assert info["selected_assets"][0] == "USDT"
    assert "RISKUSDT" not in symbols and "OFFUSDT" not in symbols
    assert len(symbols) == 99 and info["websocket_shards"] == 5


def test_ranking_does_not_compare_raw_tmn_volume_without_fx():
    markets = [{
        "symbol": f"A{n}USDT", "base_asset": f"A{n}", "quote_asset": "USDT", "is_spot": True,
        "quote_volume_24h": str(100 - n), "flags": [],
    } for n in range(25)]
    markets.append({
        "symbol": "WHALETMN", "base_asset": "WHALE", "quote_asset": "TMN", "is_spot": True,
        "quote_volume_24h": "999999999999", "flags": [],
    })

    symbols, _ = collector_module.select_universe(markets, 25)

    assert "WHALETMN" not in symbols
    assert (2 * collector_module.MAX_ASSETS + collector_module.CANDLE_BATCH - 1) // collector_module.CANDLE_BATCH <= 120


def test_asset_count_boundaries_and_429_backoff(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    import aiohttp
    import pytest

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="25..500"):
        collector_module.select_universe([], 24)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="25..500"):
        collector_module.select_universe([], 501)
    assert collector_module.select_universe([], 500)[0] == []

    class Gate:
        interval = 0.25
        async def wait(self):
            pass
        async def penalize(self):
            self.interval *= 2

    calls = 0
    async def get_text(_session, _path, **_params):
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        if calls == 1:
            raise aiohttp.ClientResponseError(None, (), status=429, headers={"Retry-After": "0"})
        return "ok"

    async def no_sleep(_delay):
        pass

    db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "rate.db")
    collector = Collector(db, _Segments(), ["BTCUSDT"])
    collector.rest_rate = Gate()
    monkeypatch.setattr(collector_module.wallex, "get_text", get_text)
    monkeypatch.setattr(collector_module.asyncio, "sleep", no_sleep)

    assert asyncio.run(collector.rest_text(None, "/v1/depth", symbol="BTCUSDT")) == "ok"
    assert calls == 2 and collector.rest_rate.interval == 0.5
    assert db.c.execute("select flag from quality_events").fetchall() == [("RATE_LIMIT",)]

"""Decimal parsing, quote quality, raw segments and point-in-time bars."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from gym.adapters.store import SegmentWriter
from gym.domain.bars import BarSpec, Consolidator, quote_bars

# Real frames captured from wss://api.wallex.ir/connection/websocket on 2026-10-30.
WS_DEPTH = ('{"push":{"channel":"orderbook:BTCTMN@buyDepth","pub":{"data":{"message":[{"price":21038000010,'
            '"quantity":0.05229445,"sum":1100170639.6229446},{"price":21038000000,"quantity":0.00001245,"sum":261923.1},'
            '{"price":21022500222,"quantity":0.004329,"sum":91006403.461038}]}}}}')
WS_ASK = ('{"push":{"channel":"orderbook:BTCTMN@sellDepth","pub":{"data":{"message":[{"price":21079999645,'
          '"quantity":0.000919,"sum":19372519.673755},{"price":21079999646,"quantity":0.00474383,"sum":99999934.72068419},'
          '{"price":21079999647,"quantity":0.004,"sum":84319998.588}]}}}}')
WS_TRADE = ('{"push":{"channel":"public:BTCTMN@trade","pub":{"data":{"isBuyOrder":true,"price":"21038000010",'
            '"quantity":"0.00001399","timestamp":"2026-10-30T20:53:00Z"}}}}')


def test_exact_decimals_never_float():
    lv = levels(loads(WS_DEPTH)["push"]["pub"]["data"]["message"])
    assert lv[0] == (Decimal("21038000010"), Decimal("0.05229445"))
    assert str(loads('{"x":1100170639.6229446}')["x"]) == "1100170639.6229446"
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        dec(0.1)


def test_book_quality_flags():
    now = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 12, tzinfo=UTC)
    side = lambda p: BookSide([(Decimal(p), Decimal(1))] * 3, now)  # noqa: E731
    assert book_top("X", side("101"), side("100"), now).flags == {"CROSSED"}
    assert book_top("X", side("100"), side("100"), now).flags == {"ZERO_SPREAD"}
    assert "WIDE_SPREAD" in book_top("X", side("100"), side("110"), now).flags
    ok = book_top("X", side("100"), side("100.5"), now)
    assert ok.flags == set() and ok.spread_bps == Decimal("49.88")
    assert "STALE" in book_top("X", side("100"), side("100.5"), now + timedelta(seconds=121)).flags
    assert "STALE" in book_top("X", None, side("100.5"), now).flags
    assert "NON_FINITE" in book_top("X", BookSide([(Decimal("NaN"), Decimal(1))], now), side("1"), now).flags


def test_collector_segments_and_change_only_tops(tmp_path):

def test_bars_are_closed_point_in_time_and_match_streaming():
    rows = quote_history(400) + [quote(START + timedelta(seconds=4005), "1", "2", ["STALE"])]
    spec = BarSpec("15min", "MID")
    c, live = Consolidator("BTCUSDT", spec), []
    for x in rows[:-1]:
        live += c.update(x.ts_avail, spec.price(x))
    assert live == quote_bars("BTCUSDT", spec, rows)  # streaming == batch, and STALE quotes never become bars
    assert all(b.avail == b.end and not b.forming for b in live)
    assert all(b.start.minute % 15 == 0 and b.end - b.start == spec.step for b in live)
    f = c.forming(START + timedelta(seconds=3995))
    assert f.forming and f not in live
    assert c.scan(f.end) and c.forming(f.end) is None  # quiet market: the clock closes the bar
    bid, ask = quote_bars("X", BarSpec("15min", "BID"), rows), quote_bars("X", BarSpec("15min", "ASK"), rows)
    assert all(a.close - b.close == 10 for a, b in zip(ask, bid))  # separate bid and ask series
    day = BarSpec("1day").bucket(datetime(2026, 10, 29, 22, tzinfo=UTC))
    assert day.astimezone(TEHRAN).hour == 0 and day.astimezone(TEHRAN).day == 30  # Tehran midnight

"""Reproducible observed spreads and their user-facing CLI report."""

from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

def observation(spread, at=START, symbol="BTCUSDT"):
    half = Decimal(spread) / 2
    return replace(quote(at, str(10000 - half), str(10000 + half)), symbol=symbol)


def test_spreads_use_exact_decimals_venue_hours_and_qualified_snapshots(tmp_path):
    rows = [observation(value) for value in ("2", "4", "6", "8")]
    rows += [observation("10", START + timedelta(minutes=30)), observation("20", symbol="USDTTMN")]
    rows += [quote(START, "NaN", "1"), quote(START, "10", "11", ["STALE"])]
    rows += [observation("100", START + timedelta(hours=1))]
    db = market_db(tmp_path, rows)
    report = spread_report(db, START, START + timedelta(hours=1))
    assert report["samples"] == 6 and report["excluded"] == 2
    first = report["groups"][0]
    assert first["symbol"] == "BTCUSDT" and first["tehran_hour"] == 12 and first["samples"] == 4
    assert first["spread_bps"] == {"min": "2.0000", "median": "5.0000", "p95": "8.0000", "max": "8.0000"}
    assert report["groups"][1]["tehran_hour"] == 13
    assert report == spread_report(db, START, START + timedelta(hours=1))
    demo = spread_report(db, START, START + timedelta(hours=1), store="demo")
    assert demo["synthetic"] and any("not venue-cost evidence" in message for message in demo["limitations"])

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_paper_sessions.py ===
"""Deterministic replays and paper-session lifecycle boundaries."""
import asyncio
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from gym.adapters.run_store import run_path
from gym.domain.model import iso
from gym.domain.sim import CostModel
from gym.domain.strategy import EmaTrend
from gym.services.data_portal import DataPortal
from gym.services.paper import paper
from gym.services.session import PaperSession
from tests.support import START, market_db, quote, quote_history


def make_session(db, cost=CostModel()):
    return PaperSession(DataPortal(db), lambda t: [], EmaTrend(1, 2), "BTCUSDT", START, "1min", Decimal(1000), cost)

def test_replay_is_deterministic_and_waterfall_reconciles(tmp_path):
    db = market_db(tmp_path, quote_history())
    a = paper(db, "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(hours=6), resolution="1min", fast=3, slow=8)
    b = paper(db, "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(hours=6), resolution="1min", fast=3, slow=8)
    assert a == b and a["result"]["fills"] >= 2
    w = {k: Decimal(v) for k, v in a["result"]["end"]["waterfall"].items()}
    assert w["directional"] + w["spread"] + w["fees"] + w["latency_drift"] == w["net"]
    assert w["fees"] < 0 and w["spread"] < 0
    first = a["result"]["decisions"][0]
    assert first["action"] == "ABSTAIN_WARMUP"  # warmup never fabricates a signal
    assert set(a["baselines"]) == {"hold USDT", "hold BTC"} and a["baselines"]["hold BTC"]["fills"] == 1
    assert [row["name"] for row in a["ranking"]["abstainers"]] == ["hold USDT"]
    active = a["ranking"]["active"]
    assert all(row["classification"] == "ACTIVE" and row["net_usdt_eq"] is not None for row in active)
    assert [Decimal(row["net_usdt_eq"]) for row in active] == sorted(
        (Decimal(row["net_usdt_eq"]) for row in active), reverse=True
    )
    c = paper(db, "BTCUSDT", START, START + timedelta(hours=6), resolution="1min", fast=3, slow=8, cost=CostModel(fee_rate=Decimal("0.004")))
    assert c["run_id"] != a["run_id"] and Decimal(c["result"]["end"]["net"]) < Decimal(a["result"]["end"]["net"])


def test_lifecycle_pending_and_abort(tmp_path):
    s = make_session(market_db(tmp_path, []))
    for sec, price in ((0, "100"), (60, "101"), (120, "102")):
        s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=sec), price, str(Decimal(price) + 1)))
    assert s.pending and s.book.get("BTC") == 0
    assert s.running_at == START + timedelta(minutes=2)
    s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=121), "102", "103"))
    assert not s.pending and s.book.get("BTC") > 0
    held = s.book.get("BTC")
    s.finish(START + timedelta(seconds=122), "operator stopped")
    assert s.state == "ABORTED" and s.book.get("BTC") == held  # no automatic liquidation
    assert s.events[-1]["reason"] == "operator stopped"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=123), "102", "103"))


def test_finish_pending_and_gaps(tmp_path):
    s = make_session(market_db(tmp_path, []))
    for sec in (0, 60, 120):
        s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=sec), str(100 + sec), str(101 + sec)))
    assert s.pending
    s.finish(START + timedelta(seconds=120))
    assert s.state == "ENDED" and not s.pending
    assert s.orders[-1]["reason"] == "SESSION_ENDED_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT"
    g = make_session(s.portal.db)
    g.feed(quote(START, "100", "101"))
    g.feed(quote(START + timedelta(hours=1), "102", "103"))
    assert g.skipped and len(g.decisions) == 1


def test_finishing_settles_without_new_intents(tmp_path):
    s = make_session(market_db(tmp_path, []))
    for sec in (0, 60, 120):
        s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=sec), str(100 + sec), str(101 + sec)))
    s.transition("FINISHING", START + timedelta(seconds=120))
    n = len(s.decisions)
    s.feed(quote(START + timedelta(seconds=121), "220", "221"))
    s.finish(START + timedelta(seconds=122))
    assert s.orders[0]["status"] == "FILLED" and len(s.decisions) == n
    assert s.state == "ENDED"


def test_live_watch_abort_preserves_record(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from gym.services import live_paper
    db = market_db(tmp_path, quote_history(n=30))
    times = iter([START, START + timedelta(seconds=130), START + timedelta(seconds=131)])
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_paper, "now_utc", lambda: next(times))
    async def interrupt(_):
        raise asyncio.CancelledError()
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_paper.asyncio, "sleep", interrupt)
    out = asyncio.run(live_paper.watch(db, tmp_path / "runs", "BTCUSDT", 1000, "1min", 1, 2, Decimal(1000)))
    assert out["result"]["session"]["state"] == "ABORTED"
    assert run_path(tmp_path / "runs", out["run_id"]).exists()


def test_live_duration_stops_intents_at_deadline(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from gym.services import live_paper
    db = market_db(tmp_path, quote_history(n=30))
    times = iter([START, START + timedelta(seconds=130), START + timedelta(seconds=190), START + timedelta(seconds=191)])
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_paper, "now_utc", lambda: next(times))
    async def no_wait(_):
        return None
    monkeypatch.setattr(live_paper.asyncio, "sleep", no_wait)
    out = asyncio.run(live_paper.watch(db, tmp_path / "runs", "BTCUSDT", 5, "1min", 1, 2, Decimal(1000)))
    r = out["result"]
    assert r["session"]["state"] == "ENDED"
    assert max(d["t"] for d in r["decisions"]) <= iso(START + timedelta(seconds=125))
    assert any(e["state"] == "FINISHING" and e["t"] == iso(START + timedelta(seconds=125)) for e in r["session"]["events"])

"""PriceBand vetoes (side-specific, Tehran-day reference) and reopening gap marks (SIM-04)."""
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from gym.domain.model import BookTop, InstrumentId
from gym.domain.rules import evaluate, parse_rule
from gym.domain.sim import CashBook, CostModel, Spec, market_order
from gym.services.data_portal import DataPortal
from gym.services.session import PaperSession
from gym.services.rules import RuleService
from gym.domain.strategy import BuyAndHold

from .support import START, market_db

USDT = InstrumentId.wallex("USDTTMN")


def band(**params):
    return parse_rule({"id": "usdt-band", "family": "PriceBand", "class": "VENUE", "action": "BLOCK_ENTRY",
                       "scope": {"venue": "wallex", "symbols": ["USDTTMN"], "side": "BUY"},
                       "params": {"max_change_pct": "4", "direction": "UP", **params},
                       "effective_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "source": "announcement", "status": "VERIFIED"})


def test_price_band_validation():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        band(direction="SIDEWAYS")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        band(max_change_pct=4.0)


def test_price_band_is_side_specific_and_warns_without_reference():
    rules = [band()]
    assert not evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", START, day_change_pct=Decimal("4.10")).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", START, day_change_pct=Decimal("3.99")).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "SELL", "EXIT", START, day_change_pct=Decimal("9")).allowed
    unknown = evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", START)
    assert unknown.allowed and "day reference unknown" in unknown.warnings[0]["why"]


def test_simulator_band_lock_is_a_nonfill():
    top = BookTop("USDTTMN", START, Decimal(104900), Decimal(105000), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())
    book = CashBook({"TMN": Decimal(1_000_000)})
    cost = CostModel(latency=timedelta(0))
    out = market_order(book, USDT, "BUY", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(105000), [top], 0, cost, Spec(None, None, None),
                       [band()], {}, "USDTTMN#1", day_open=Decimal(100000))
    assert out["status"] == "NONFILL" and out["reason"] == "RULE:usdt-band"
    assert book.get("TMN") == Decimal(1_000_000)


def test_reopening_gap_is_marked_once(tmp_path):
    # USDTTMN closes 23:30-11:30 Tehran (20:00-08:00 UTC) after 2026-10-18.
    before = START.replace(hour=19, minute=50)  # 23:20 Tehran
    rows = [BookTop("USDTTMN", before + timedelta(seconds=10 * i), Decimal(100000), Decimal(100010), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())
            for i in range(30)]
    reopen = START.replace(hour=8, minute=0) + timedelta(days=1)
    rows += [BookTop("USDTTMN", reopen + timedelta(seconds=10 * i), Decimal(103000), Decimal(103010), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())
             for i in range(30)]
    db = market_db(tmp_path, rows)
    portal = DataPortal(db)
    rules = RuleService(db).load(START)[1]
    session = PaperSession(portal, lambda t: rules, BuyAndHold(), "USDTTMN", before, "1min", Decimal(1_000_000),
                           CostModel(latency=timedelta(seconds=1)))
    for row in rows:
        session.feed(row)
    session.finish(rows[-1].ts_avail)
    assert len(session.reopenings) == 1
    gap = session.reopenings[0]
    held = Decimal(gap["base_held"])
    assert held > 0 and Decimal(gap["gap_value"]) == held * 3000
    assert gap["first_quote"].startswith("2026-10-30T08:00:00") and gap["reopened_at"].startswith("2026-10-30T08:00:00")
    assert session.curve[-1][0] >= gap["first_quote"]

from pathlib import Path

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_restore_gate.py ===
"""B3 offline ledger restore verification never overwrites an active ledger."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sqlite3

import pytest

from gym.services.restore_gate import RestoreUnsafe, inspect_ledger, check_restore_target

def _symlink_or_skip(link, target):
    try:
        link.symlink_to(target)
    except OSError as exc:  # Windows without SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege
        pytest.skip(f"symlinks unavailable: {exc}")


def make_candidate(path: Path, values=(b"first",)):
    schema = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "executor/exec-store/schema.sql").read_text()
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.executescript(schema)
    previous = bytes(32)
    for n, value in enumerate(values, 1):
        h = hashlib.sha256(previous + len(value).to_bytes(8, "big") + value).digest()
        db.execute("INSERT INTO ledger_events(sequence,event_bytes,previous_hash,event_hash) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                   (n, value, previous, h))
        previous = h
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return previous.hex()


def test_verified_staged_restore_has_exact_stored_byte_chain(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    expected = make_candidate(path, (b'{"a":1}', b'{"a":2}'))
    evidence = inspect_ledger(path)
    assert evidence["sequence"] == 2
    assert evidence["head_hash"] == expected
    assert evidence["schema_version"] == 1
    assert evidence["encrypted"] is False


def test_altered_bytes_and_missing_sequence_fail_closed(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    make_candidate(path, (b"one", b"two"))
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("DROP TRIGGER ledger_events_no_update")
    db.execute("UPDATE ledger_events SET event_bytes=? WHERE sequence=1", (b"evil",))
    db.executescript("CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON ledger_events "
                     "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger events are immutable'); END;")
    db.commit(); db.close()
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="hash"):
        inspect_ledger(path)


def test_gap_and_missing_guard_fail_closed(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    make_candidate(path, (b"one", b"two"))
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("DROP TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete")
    db.execute("DELETE FROM ledger_events WHERE sequence=1")
    db.executescript("CREATE TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON ledger_events "
                     "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger events are immutable'); END;")
    db.commit(); db.close()
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="sequence"):
        inspect_ledger(path)
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("DROP TRIGGER ledger_events_no_delete")
    db.commit(); db.close()
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="guard"):
        inspect_ledger(path)


def test_future_schema_and_sidecars_are_rejected(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    make_candidate(path)
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("PRAGMA user_version=99")
    db.commit(); db.close()
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="schema"):
        inspect_ledger(path)
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute("PRAGMA user_version=1")
    db.commit(); db.close()
    (tmp_path / "snapshot.db-wal").write_bytes(b"uncommitted")
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="sidecar"):
        inspect_ledger(path)


def test_restore_refuses_preexisting_destination_and_backup_secrets(tmp_path):
    src, dst = tmp_path / "snapshot.db", tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    make_candidate(src)
    dst.write_bytes(b"do not touch me")
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="exists"):
        check_restore_target(src, dst)
    assert dst.read_bytes() == b"do not touch me"
    dst.unlink()
    (tmp_path / "secrets.dat").write_bytes(b"no")
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="secrets.dat"):
        check_restore_target(src, dst)


def test_no_restore_from_symlink_or_nonexistent_file(tmp_path):
    src = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    make_candidate(src)
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe):
        inspect_ledger(tmp_path / "missing.db")
    link = tmp_path / "link.db"
    _symlink_or_skip(link, src)
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe):
        inspect_ledger(link)


def test_staged_restore_can_be_pinned_to_independently_verified_manifest(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    head = make_candidate(path, (b"first", b"second"))
    import hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    from gym.services.restore_gate import inspect_pinned_ledger
    report = inspect_pinned_ledger(
        path, expected_head_hash=head, expected_file_sha256=digest
    )
    assert report["head_hash"] == head
    assert report["file_sha256"] == digest
    assert report["trusted_origin"] is False  # comparison is not authentication


def test_staged_restore_rejects_manifest_mismatches_and_bad_digests(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "snapshot.db"
    head = make_candidate(path)
    from gym.services.restore_gate import inspect_pinned_ledger, RestoreUnsafe
    import hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="head"):
        inspect_pinned_ledger(path, expected_head_hash="1" * 64,
                              expected_file_sha256=digest)
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="file"):
        inspect_pinned_ledger(path, expected_head_hash=head,
                              expected_file_sha256="f" * 64)
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="digest"):
        inspect_pinned_ledger(path, expected_head_hash="not-hex",
                              expected_file_sha256=digest)


def test_staged_restore_preserves_existing_destination_under_manifest_checks(tmp_path):
    from gym.services.restore_gate import check_pinned_restore_target, RestoreUnsafe
    path, dest = tmp_path / "snapshot.db", tmp_path / "exec_ledger.db"
    head = make_candidate(path)
    import hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    dest.write_bytes(b"active money ledger must not be overwritten")
    with pytest.raises(RestoreUnsafe, match="exists"):
        check_pinned_restore_target(
            path, dest, expected_head_hash=head, expected_file_sha256=digest
        )
    assert dest.read_bytes() == b"active money ledger must not be overwritten"

"""Rule scopes, precedence, quarantining and historical versions."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from gym.adapters.store import MarketDB
from gym.domain.model import TEHRAN, UTC, BookTop, InstrumentId
from gym.domain.rules import PRESETS, evaluate, next_change, parse_rule
from gym.services.rules import RuleService
from gym.services.paper import paper
from tests.support import START, market_db, quote_history


USDT, BTCT, BTCU = (InstrumentId.wallex(s) for s in ("USDTTMN", "BTCTMN", "BTCUSDT"))


def tehran_time(s):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s).replace(tzinfo=TEHRAN).astimezone(UTC)


def restriction(**kw):
    base = {"id": "r", "family": "PairSuspension", "class": "VENUE", "action": "BLOCK_ALL", "scope": {"symbols": ["BTCTMN"]},
            "effective_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "source": "operator", "status": "VERIFIED"}
    return parse_rule({**base, **kw})




def test_usdt_closure_is_pair_scoped():
    rules = [parse_rule(d) for d in PRESETS["usdt-irt-october-2026"]]
    night = tehran_time("2026-10-31T00:30")
    for intent, side in (("ENTRY", "BUY"), ("EXIT", "SELL")):
        v = evaluate(rules, USDT, side, intent, night)
        assert not v.allowed and v.blockers[0]["rule_id"] == "wallex-usdttmn-closure-2330-1130"
        assert v.blockers[0]["class"] == "VENUE" and v.blockers[0]["source"] == "announcement"
        assert evaluate(rules, BTCT, side, intent, night).allowed
        assert evaluate(rules, BTCU, side, intent, night).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", tehran_time("2026-10-31T12:00")).allowed
    assert next_change(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", night) == tehran_time("2026-10-31T11:30")
    # The earlier 21:00-09:00 vintage applies before 18 October.
    assert not evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", tehran_time("2026-10-10T21:30")).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", tehran_time("2026-10-10T09:30")).allowed


def test_quota_counts_and_resets():
    rules = [parse_rule(d) for d in PRESETS["usdt-irt-october-2026"]]
    noon = tehran_time("2026-10-31T12:00")
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", noon, used=Decimal(1500)).quota_remaining == Decimal(500)
    full = evaluate(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", noon, used=Decimal(2000))
    assert not full.allowed and full.blockers[0]["family"] == "VenueQuota"
    assert evaluate(rules, USDT, "SELL", "EXIT", noon, used=Decimal(2000)).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, BTCU, "BUY", "ENTRY", noon, used=Decimal(2000)).allowed  # spending USDT is not buying it
    # Exhausted quota at noon: closure starts 23:30, and the cap resets at Tehran midnight, still inside the closure.
    assert next_change(rules, USDT, "BUY", "ENTRY", noon, used=Decimal(2000)) == tehran_time("2026-11-01T11:30")


def test_rule_precedence_preserves_exit_permissions():
    now = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 12, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert evaluate([restriction(**{"class": "SCENARIO"})], BTCT, "SELL", "ENTRY", now).allowed
    assert not evaluate([restriction(**{"class": "SCENARIO"})], BTCT, "SELL", "ENTRY", now, live=False).allowed
    pol = restriction(**{"class": "POLICY", "status": "VERIFIED"})
    assert not evaluate([pol], BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", now).allowed
    v = evaluate([pol], BTCT, "SELL", "EXIT", now)
    assert v.allowed and v.warnings  # ordinary POLICY never blocks an exit, but says it would
    assert not evaluate([restriction(**{"class": "POLICY", "exit_confirmed": True})], BTCT, "SELL", "EXIT", now).allowed
    inf = restriction(status="INFERRED", last_confirmed_at="2026-10-28T00:00:00Z")
    assert evaluate([inf], BTCT, "SELL", "EXIT", now).allowed
    e = evaluate([inf], BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", now)
    assert not e.allowed and e.blockers[0]["status"] == "STALE"  # stale, not void
    assert evaluate([restriction(action="WARN")], BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", now).warnings


def test_malformed_rules_quarantined(tmp_path):
    svc = RuleService(MarketDB(tmp_path / "m.db"))
    now = datetime(2026, 10, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
    res = svc.import_([{"id": "bad", "family": "Nope"}, {"id": "tw", "family": "TradingWindow", "class": "VENUE",
                       "action": "BLOCK_ALL", "params": {}, "effective_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
                       "source": "operator", "status": "VERIFIED"}], now)
    assert {q["id"] for q in res["quarantined"]} == {"bad", "tw"}
    _, rules, q = svc.load()
    assert rules == [] and len(q) == 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        svc.put({"id": "x", "effective_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00"}, now)  # unzoned date is rejected outright


def test_rule_ledger_versions_and_rollback(tmp_path):
    db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "m.db")
    svc = RuleService(db)
    t0 = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 10, tzinfo=UTC)
    d = {"id": "s", "family": "PairSuspension", "class": "VENUE", "action": "BLOCK_ENTRY", "scope": {"symbols": ["BTCTMN"]},
         "effective_from": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "source": "operator", "status": "VERIFIED"}
    s1 = svc.put(d, t0)
    assert not svc.check(BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", t0)["allowed"]
    svc.disable("s", t0 + timedelta(hours=1))
    assert svc.check(BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", t0 + timedelta(hours=2))["allowed"]  # next evaluation, no restart
    # Point-in-time vintage: as recorded before the disable, the suspension still applied.
    assert not svc.check(BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", t0, at_rules=t0 + timedelta(minutes=30))["allowed"]
    v = svc.rollback("s", s1, t0 + timedelta(hours=3))
    r = svc.check(BTCT, "BUY", "ENTRY", t0 + timedelta(hours=4))
    assert not r["allowed"] and r["ruleset_version"] == v
    assert [e["op"] for e in db.rule_events("s")] == ["add", "disable", "rollback"]


def test_replay_respects_rule_vintages(tmp_path):
    rows = quote_history(3000, sym="USDTTMN")
    rows = [BookTop("USDTTMN", x.ts_avail + timedelta(hours=10), x.bid / 250, x.ask / 250, Decimal(1), Decimal(1), x.flags) for x in rows]
    late = START + timedelta(days=1)  # rules recorded after the window
    db = market_db(tmp_path, rows, preset_at=late)
    t0, t1 = rows[0].ts_avail, rows[-1].ts_avail
    pit = paper(db, "USDTTMN", t0, t1, resolution="1min", fast=3, slow=8)
    now = paper(db, "USDTTMN", t0, t1, resolution="1min", fast=3, slow=8, rules_mode="today")
    assert not any("RULE:" in r for r in pit["result"]["nonfills"])
    assert any("RULE:" in r for r in now["result"]["nonfills"]) and any("TODAY" in w for w in now["warnings"])

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_run_store.py ===
"""Run artifacts are atomic, immutable and confined to validated filenames."""
import json
import os

import pytest

from gym.adapters.run_store import list_runs, load_run, run_path, save_run


RUN_ID = "0123456789abcdef"


def test_save_is_idempotent_and_refuses_different_results(tmp_path):
    record = {"run_id": RUN_ID, "inputs": {}, "result": {"end": {"net": "1"}}}
    path = save_run(record, tmp_path)
    assert save_run(record, tmp_path) == path
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different results"):
        save_run({**record, "result": {"end": {"net": "2"}}}, tmp_path)
    assert json.loads(path.read_text("utf-8")) == record
    assert len(list(tmp_path.iterdir())) == 1
    assert list_runs(tmp_path) == [{"run_id": RUN_ID, "inputs": {}, "end": {"net": "1"}}]
    assert load_run(tmp_path, RUN_ID)["capital_decisions"] == []


def test_competing_save_never_overwrites_a_run(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    record = {"run_id": RUN_ID, "result": "first"}
    competitor = {"run_id": RUN_ID, "result": "second"}
    link = os.link

    def competing_link(source, destination):
        destination.write_text(json.dumps(competitor), "utf-8")
        link(source, destination)

    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "link", competing_link)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="different results"):
        save_run(record, tmp_path)
    assert json.loads(run_path(tmp_path, RUN_ID).read_text("utf-8")) == competitor
    assert len(list(tmp_path.iterdir())) == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("run_id", ["../escape", "ABCDEF0123456789", "0123456789abcde", "0123456789abcdef.json"])
def test_invalid_run_ids_are_rejected(tmp_path, run_id):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="16 lowercase hex"):
        run_path(tmp_path, run_id)

import os

import pytest

from gym.adapters import secret_store

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "nt", reason="DPAPI is Windows-only")


def test_dpapi_round_trip_never_stores_plaintext(tmp_path):
    key = "12345|abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJ0123456789"
    path = secret_store.save("read", key, tmp_path)
    assert key.encode() not in path.read_bytes()
    assert secret_store.load("read", tmp_path) == key
    assert secret_store.masked(key) == "12345|…6789"


def test_rejects_bad_role_garbage_and_missing(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        secret_store.save("withdraw", "1|abcdefghijABCDEFGHIJ0123", tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        secret_store.save("read", "not a key", tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no trade key"):
        secret_store.load("trade", tmp_path)

"""Trading-session bars, the stale FX factor during closures, and IRT unit discontinuities."""
import json
from dataclasses import replace
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from gym.adapters.store import MarketDB, SegmentWriter
from gym.domain.bars import BarSpec, Consolidator, quote_bars
from gym.domain.model import TEHRAN, UTC, BookSide, InstrumentId
from gym.domain.rules import PRESETS, evaluate, is_closed, parse_rule, session_period
from gym.domain.units import UnitWatch, rescale_exponent
from gym.services.collector import Collector
from gym.services.paper import paper
from tests.support import START, market_db, quote

RULES = [parse_rule(d) for d in PRESETS["usdt-irt-october-2026"]]
USDT, BTC = InstrumentId.wallex("USDTTMN"), InstrumentId.wallex("BTCTMN")


def teh(text):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(text).replace(tzinfo=TEHRAN).astimezone(UTC)


def test_session_is_the_open_stretch_between_closures():
    assert session_period(RULES, USDT, teh("2026-10-31T12:00")) == (teh("2026-10-31T11:30"), teh("2026-10-31T23:30"))
    assert session_period(RULES, USDT, teh("2026-10-31T23:45")) == (teh("2026-10-31T23:30"), teh("2026-11-01T11:30"))
    # The earlier 21:00-09:00 vintage bounds sessions before 18 October.
    assert session_period(RULES, USDT, teh("2026-10-10T12:00")) == (teh("2026-10-10T09:00"), teh("2026-10-10T21:00"))
    # A pair with no closure gets one session per Tehran day.
    assert session_period(RULES, BTC, teh("2026-10-31T12:00")) == (teh("2026-10-31T00:00"), teh("2026-11-01T00:00"))
    assert is_closed(RULES, USDT, teh("2026-10-31T02:00")) and not is_closed(RULES, BTC, teh("2026-10-31T02:00"))


def test_session_bars_need_rules_and_close_at_the_closure():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="period"):
        Consolidator("USDTTMN", BarSpec("session"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="trading-window"):
        BarSpec("session").bucket(START)
    period = lambda t: session_period(RULES, USDT, t)  # noqa: E731
    tops = [replace(quote(teh("2026-10-31T12:00") + timedelta(hours=h), str(100 + h), str(101 + h)), symbol="USDTTMN")
            for h in range(11)]
    tops.append(replace(quote(teh("2026-11-01T12:00"), "200", "201"), symbol="USDTTMN"))
    bars = quote_bars("USDTTMN", BarSpec("session"), tops, period)
    assert [(b.start, b.end, b.avail) for b in bars] == [(teh("2026-10-31T11:30"), teh("2026-10-31T23:30"),
                                                          teh("2026-10-31T23:30"))]
    assert bars[0].open == Decimal("100.5") and bars[0].close == Decimal("110.5") and bars[0].count == 11


def test_replay_records_closures_as_closed_not_as_missing_data(tmp_path):
    t0, t1 = teh("2026-10-31T21:00"), teh("2026-11-01T14:00")
    open_hours = [teh("2026-10-31T21:00") + timedelta(minutes=m) for m in range(0, 150, 1)]
    open_hours += [teh("2026-11-01T11:30") + timedelta(minutes=m) for m in range(0, 150, 1)]
    rows = [replace(quote(t, str(1000 + i % 7), str(1002 + i % 7)), symbol="USDTTMN") for i, t in enumerate(open_hours)]
    out = paper(market_db(tmp_path, rows), "USDTTMN", t0, t1, resolution="1h", fast=2, slow=3)
    reasons = {(s["from"][:16], s["reason"]) for s in out["result"]["session"]["skipped"]}
    assert ("2026-10-31T20:00", "VENUE_CLOSED") in reasons  # 23:30 Tehran closure starts inside the 20:00Z bar
    assert not any(r == "NO_OBSERVATIONS" for _, r in reasons)


def test_fx_factor_is_labeled_stale_while_usdt_irt_is_closed(tmp_path):
    t0, t1 = teh("2026-10-31T12:00"), teh("2026-11-01T01:00")  # ends inside the 23:30-11:30 closure
    steps = int((t1 - t0).total_seconds() // 60)
    rows = [replace(quote(t0 + timedelta(minutes=i), "1000", "1002"), symbol="USDTTMN") for i in range(0, 690)]
    rows += [replace(quote(t0 + timedelta(minutes=i), str(70000000 + i), str(70000100 + i)), symbol="BTCTMN")
             for i in range(steps)]
    out = paper(market_db(tmp_path, rows), "BTCTMN", t0, t1, resolution="15min", fast=2, slow=3)
    assert (out["fx"]["start_status"], out["fx"]["end_status"]) == ("LIVE", "STALE_CLOSED")
    assert any("STALE_CLOSED" in w for w in out["warnings"])


def test_rescale_exponent_recognises_only_powers_of_ten():
    assert rescale_exponent(Decimal("0.001")) == -3 and rescale_exponent(Decimal("1000.9")) == 3
    assert rescale_exponent(Decimal("1.04")) is None and rescale_exponent(Decimal("3")) is None


def mids(scale, drift=Decimal(1)):
    usdt = Decimal("100000") * scale * drift
    return {("USDT", "TMN"): usdt, ("BTC", "USDT"): Decimal("70000") * drift,
            ("BTC", "TMN"): Decimal("70000") * usdt * drift, ("ETH", "USDT"): Decimal("2500"),
            ("ETH", "TMN"): Decimal("2500") * usdt}


def test_unit_watch_ignores_market_moves_and_lone_glitches():
    watch = UnitWatch()
    assert watch.observe(mids(1)) is None
    assert watch.observe(mids(1, Decimal("1.3"))) is None  # a 30% crash in IRT is a market move, not a unit change
    glitch = mids(1, Decimal("1.3")) | {("ETH", "TMN"): mids(1, Decimal("1.3"))["ETH", "TMN"] * 1000}
    assert watch.observe(glitch) is None  # one asset alone is not a redenomination


def test_redenomination_freezes_irt_entries_but_never_exits(tmp_path):
    db = MarketDB(tmp_path / "market.db")
    symbols = ["USDTTMN", "BTCTMN", "BTCUSDT", "ETHTMN", "ETHUSDT"]
    col = Collector(db, SegmentWriter(tmp_path / "raw", db), symbols)
    now = START

    def show(scale, at):
        for (base, quote_ccy), mid in mids(scale).items():
            side = lambda p: BookSide([(p, Decimal(1))] * 3, at)  # noqa: E731
            col.books[base + quote_ccy] = {"bid": side(mid * Decimal("0.9999")), "ask": side(mid * Decimal("1.0001"))}
        col.tick(at)

    show(Decimal(1), now)
    show(Decimal("0.001"), now + timedelta(seconds=2))  # every IRT price /1000 at once; USDT prices unchanged
    flags = db.c.execute("select detail from quality_events where flag='UNIT_DISCONTINUITY'").fetchall()
    assert len(flags) == 1 and json.loads(flags[0][0])["exponent"] == -3
    rules = [parse_rule(d) for d in db.rules_as_of()[1].values()]
    later = now + timedelta(minutes=1)
    assert not evaluate(rules, BTC, "BUY", "ENTRY", later).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, BTC, "SELL", "EXIT", later).allowed
    assert evaluate(rules, InstrumentId.wallex("BTCUSDT"), "BUY", "ENTRY", later).allowed
    show(Decimal("0.001"), now + timedelta(seconds=4))  # the new level is the new reference: no repeat event
    assert db.c.execute("select count(*) from quality_events where flag='UNIT_DISCONTINUITY'").fetchone()[0] == 1
    # Stored observations are kept exactly as observed (change-only: the repeat is not rewritten).
    stored = db.c.execute("select bid from book_top where instrument_id='wallex:USDTTMN' order by ts_avail").fetchall()
    assert [Decimal(b) for (b,) in stored] == [Decimal("99990.0000"), Decimal("99.9900000")]

"""Simulated order settlement, quota sizing and cash accounting."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from gym.domain.model import UTC, BookTop, InstrumentId
from gym.domain.rules import PRESETS, parse_rule
from gym.domain.sim import CashBook, CostModel, Spec, market_order
from tests.support import START, quote




def test_orders_fill_after_latency_on_the_correct_side():
    inst = InstrumentId.wallex("BTCUSDT")
    q = [quote(START, "100", "101"), quote(START + timedelta(milliseconds=300), "100", "102"),
         quote(START + timedelta(seconds=1), "100", "103", ["STALE"]), quote(START + timedelta(seconds=2), "99", "104")]
    book = CashBook({"USDT": Decimal(1000)})
    o = market_order(book, inst, "BUY", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(101), q, 0, CostModel(), Spec(), [], {}, "o1")
    # Not the triggering quote, not inside the latency, not a STALE one: the first qualified quote after 500 ms.
    assert o["status"] == "FILLED" and o["price"] == "104" and o["fill_time"].startswith("2026-10-29T09:00:02")
    assert o["costs"]["latency_drift"] == Decimal(3) * Decimal(o["qty"])
    s = market_order(book, inst, "SELL", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(100), q, 0, CostModel(), Spec(), [], {}, "o2")
    assert s["price"] == "99" and s["fee_ccy"] == "USDT"
    late = market_order(book, inst, "BUY", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(101), q[:1], 0, CostModel(), Spec(), [], {}, "o3")
    assert late == {"ref": "o3", "side": "BUY", "decision_time": late["decision_time"], "status": "NONFILL",
                    "reason": "NO_QUALIFIED_QUOTE"}
    odd = CashBook({"TMN": Decimal(300_000_000)})  # 28-digit division used to round up and overdraw
    o = market_order(odd, InstrumentId.wallex("BTCTMN"), "BUY", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(1), [BookTop("BTCTMN", START + timedelta(seconds=1),
                     Decimal(21016006081), Decimal(21016006083), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())], 0, CostModel(), Spec(), [], {}, "odd")
    assert o["status"] == "FILLED" and odd.get("TMN") >= 0
    tiny = market_order(CashBook({"USDT": Decimal(5)}), inst, "BUY", Decimal(1), START, Decimal(101), q, 0, CostModel(),
                        Spec(5, Decimal("0.00001"), Decimal(10)), [], {}, "o4")
    assert tiny["reason"] == "BELOW_MIN_NOTIONAL"  # never rounded up into exposure


def test_cashbook_charges_received_asset_fees_once():
    """§5.3: 1000 cash, buy 100 at ask 10, 0.1 base fee, mark at bid 9.9 -> equity 998.01; fee not subtracted twice."""
    inst, book = InstrumentId.wallex("BTCUSDT"), CashBook({"USDT": Decimal(1000)})
    o = market_order(book, inst, "BUY", Decimal("0.1"), START, Decimal(10), [quote(START + timedelta(seconds=1), "9.9", "10")], 0,
                     CostModel(fee_rate=Decimal("0.01")), Spec(), [], {}, "a")
    assert o["fee"] == "0.100" and book.get("USDT") == 900 and book.get("BTC") == Decimal("9.9")
    assert book.equity(inst, Decimal("9.9")) == Decimal("998.01")


def test_rules_veto_orders_and_resize_quota_excess():
    rules = [parse_rule(d) for d in PRESETS["usdt-irt-october-2026"]]
    inst = InstrumentId.wallex("USDTTMN")
    night = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 20, tzinfo=UTC)  # 23:30 Tehran: closure starts
    q = [BookTop("USDTTMN", night + timedelta(seconds=1), Decimal(273000), Decimal(273500), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())]
    o = market_order(CashBook({"TMN": Decimal(10 ** 9)}), inst, "BUY", Decimal(1), night - timedelta(seconds=1), Decimal(273500), q, 0,
                     CostModel(), Spec(), rules, {}, "n")
    assert o["status"] == "NONFILL" and o["reason"] == "RULE:wallex-usdttmn-closure-2330-1130"
    noon = datetime(2026, 10, 29, 9, tzinfo=UTC)
    q = [BookTop("USDTTMN", noon + timedelta(seconds=1), Decimal(273000), Decimal(273500), Decimal(1), Decimal(1), frozenset())]
    used = {}
    o = market_order(CashBook({"TMN": Decimal(10 ** 9)}), inst, "BUY", Decimal(1), noon, Decimal(273500), q, 0, CostModel(), Spec(2),
                     rules, used, "q")
    assert o["resized"] == "VenueQuota" and o["qty"] == "2000.00" and used[noon.date()] == Decimal(2000)


def test_cost_boundary():
    for fee in ("NaN", "Infinity", "-0.01", "1"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            CostModel(Decimal(fee))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        CostModel(latency=timedelta(seconds=-1))

"""Byte-level fixtures for IPC-only T0 stop commands (no order authority)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from gym.contracts.stop_wire import (
    StopCommand,
    StopMode,
    StopResult,
    decode_reply,
    decode_request,
    encode_reply,
    encode_request,
)

VECTORS = json.loads(
    (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "contracts/v1/fixtures/stop-wire-v1.json").read_text("utf-8")
)
CORRELATION = bytes.fromhex("000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f")
EPOCH = 0x0102030405060708


def test_fixed_size_stop_request_matches_golden_vector():
    raw = encode_request(StopCommand.PAUSE_ENTRIES, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    assert len(raw) == 40
    assert raw.hex() == VECTORS["pause_request_hex"]
    assert decode_request(raw) == (StopCommand.PAUSE_ENTRIES, EPOCH, CORRELATION)


def test_ack_reply_echoes_correlation_and_requested_epoch():
    raw = encode_reply(StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    assert len(raw) == 40
    assert raw.hex() == VECTORS["paused_ack_hex"]
    assert decode_reply(raw) == (StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH, CORRELATION)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("byte_offset", [0, 8, 10, 13, 14, 15])
def test_mutated_request_header_rejected(byte_offset):
    raw = bytearray.fromhex(VECTORS["pause_request_hex"])
    raw[byte_offset] ^= 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_request(bytes(raw))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("payload", [b"", b"G", b"\x00" * 39, b"\x00" * 41])
def test_truncated_or_oversized_request_rejected(payload):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_request(payload)


def test_unsupported_command_cannot_be_interpreted_as_t0_stop():
    raw = bytearray.fromhex(VECTORS["pause_request_hex"])
    raw[12] = 9
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_request(bytes(raw))


def test_zero_epoch_or_correlation_is_rejected():
    for kwargs in ({"epoch": 0}, {"correlation": bytes(16)}):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            encode_request(StopCommand.HALT, kwargs.get("epoch", EPOCH), kwargs.get("correlation", CORRELATION))


def test_status_read_is_only_non_mutating_stop_command():
    raw = encode_request(StopCommand.STATUS, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    assert decode_request(raw)[0] == StopCommand.STATUS


def test_bad_reply_fields_or_request_bytes_are_not_acks():
    raw = bytearray.fromhex(VECTORS["paused_ack_hex"])
    raw[12] = 2
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_reply(bytes(raw))
    raw = bytearray.fromhex(VECTORS["paused_ack_hex"])
    raw[13] = 7
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_reply(bytes(raw))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decode_reply(bytes.fromhex(VECTORS["pause_request_hex"]))


def test_client_accepts_only_the_matching_acknowledged_stop():
    from gym.contracts.stop_wire import verify_reply_for

    request = encode_request(StopCommand.PAUSE_ENTRIES, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    good = encode_reply(StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    assert verify_reply_for(request, good) == (StopMode.PAUSED, True)

    other_id = encode_reply(StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH, bytes.fromhex("010102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        verify_reply_for(request, other_id)
    other_epoch = encode_reply(StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH + 1, CORRELATION)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        verify_reply_for(request, other_epoch)
    stale = encode_reply(StopResult.STALE_RUNTIME, StopMode.DISARMED, False, EPOCH + 1, CORRELATION)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        verify_reply_for(request, stale)


def test_mismatched_or_weaker_ack_does_not_confirm_requested_stop():
    from gym.contracts.stop_wire import verify_reply_for

    request = encode_request(StopCommand.HALT, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    fake_ack = encode_reply(StopResult.ACK, StopMode.PAUSED, True, EPOCH, CORRELATION)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        verify_reply_for(request, fake_ack)

=== FILE: D:\GitHub\Trade\gym-core\tests\test_ui.py ===
"""Page structure and runtime contracts for the bundled browser application."""
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

import pytest

from gym.api.server import UI


class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.elements = []
        self.parents = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.elements.append({"tag": tag, "attrs": dict(attrs),
                              "parent": self.parents[-1] if self.parents else None})
        if tag not in {"area", "base", "br", "col", "embed", "hr", "img", "input", "link", "meta", "source", "track", "wbr"}:
            self.parents.append(len(self.elements) - 1)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        while self.parents:
            if self.elements[self.parents.pop()]["tag"] == tag:
                break


def page():
    result = Page()
    result.feed(UI.read_text("utf-8"))
    return result.elements


def node():
    executable = shutil.which("node")
    if not executable:
        pytest.skip("Node not installed; UI runtime check unavailable")
    return executable


def test_ui_navigation_and_form_labels():
    elements = page()
    ids = [e["attrs"]["id"] for e in elements if "id" in e["attrs"]]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), "Duplicate IDs make label and view targets ambiguous"
    routes = [e["attrs"]["data-view"] for e in elements if "data-view" in e["attrs"]]
    assert set(routes) == {"markets", "research", "account", "operate", "rules", "health"}
    assert len(routes) == len(set(routes))
    for route in routes:
        section = next(e for e in elements if e["attrs"].get("id") == "v-" + route)
        assert section["attrs"].get("aria-labelledby") in ids
    labels = {e["attrs"].get("for") for e in elements if e["tag"] == "label"}
    for element in elements:
        attrs = element["attrs"]
        if element["tag"] in {"input", "select", "textarea"} and attrs.get("type") != "hidden":
            assert (attrs.get("id") in labels or attrs.get("aria-label")
                    or attrs.get("aria-labelledby") in ids or attrs.get("data-t-label")), attrs


def test_ui_javascript_syntax():
    result = subprocess.run([node(), "--check", str(UI.with_name("app.js"))], capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr


def test_ui_runtime_contracts():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [node(), str(Path(__file__).with_name("ui_contract.cjs")), str(UI.with_name("app.js"))],
        input=json.dumps(page()), capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=30,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
